title: Silent Enemy

line: Stay on long-range scanners. If they come anywhere near us, I want to know. T'Pol.

line: That support frame's bent. We'll need to reinforce it.

title: Silent Enemy
line: How bad is it?

title: Silent Enemy
line: If that last shot had been about a half a meter higher we'd be looking at stars.

title: Silent Enemy
line: Hold it a minute.

title: Silent Enemy
line: There were thirteen people working in this section Captain, including yours truly. If that bulkhead had blown.

line: Did your people run into as many hostile aliens when they first went into deep space?

title: Silent Enemy
line: It was a different time.

title: Silent Enemy
line: How so?

title: Silent Enemy
line: There were fewer warp-capable species.

title: Silent Enemy
line: This ship just isn't equipped to handle some of the threats we're coming up against. It's time we do something about that.

title: Silent Enemy
line: What are you suggesting?

title: Silent Enemy
line: Enterprise was fitted with phase cannon ports, but since we left Spacedock a few weeks ahead of schedule the cannons were never installled.

title: Silent Enemy
line: I think it's time they were. We should head back to Earth.

title: Silent Enemy
line: Just give us two weeks, Captain.

title: Silent Enemy
line: I know we can do it. Most of the stuff we need is already on the ship.

title: Silent Enemy
line: The armory team at Jupiter Station is trained for this kind of work. If we're going to do this let's do it right.

title: Silent Enemy
line: My engineers are just as good as they are.

title: Silent Enemy
line: I know that, Trip, but we have other systems that could use overhauls. Look at the bright side. You'll got a chance to say goodbye to Natalie.

title: Silent Enemy
line: Sir, with your permission, we could at least begin the work, get a few things started for Jupiter Station.

title: Silent Enemy
line: It'll cut down the time we'll have to spend in Spacedock.

title: Silent Enemy
line: Do what you can. Archer to Mayweather.

title: Silent Enemy
line: Go ahead, Captain.

title: Silent Enemy
line: We're heading home.

title: Silent Enemy
line: This, ladies and gentlemen is a phase-modulated energy weapon. It's rated for a maximum power output of five hundred gigajoules. Enterprise was designed to carry three of them. We have one, and it's only a prototype.

title: Silent Enemy
line: Our job is to get it up and running and build two more from scratch. The Captain is taking us back because he thinks this ought to be done by the boys in Spacedock.

title: Silent Enemy
line: Far be it from me to question the Captain's judgment, but Commander Tucker and I believe we can do this ourselves.

title: Silent Enemy
line: That means double shifts. By the time we reach Jupiter Station, I don't want their engineers to have a thing to do but give us a wash and a wax. Any questions?

title: Silent Enemy
line: Are we expecting another attack, sir?

title: Silent Enemy
line: We all signed up for this trip because we wanted to do something no one had ever done before, not because we thought it'd be easy or safe. But we're not here to take foolish risks. The Captain and the rest of the crew are depending on us to keep Enterprise ready for anything.

title: Silent Enemy
line: And once we get these phase cannons online, we'll have a lot more firepower to do just that.

line: So what are you standing around for?

title: Silent Enemy
line: He once told me that he loved to eat octopus, especially the little suction cups, but I think he was pulling my leg. You can never tell whether my brother's joking or not. Can I talk to him?

line: We really would like to keep this a surprise.

title: Silent Enemy
line: Oh right, the dinner. I remember one time, this was at least ten years ago, he went for a whole week without eating.

title: Silent Enemy
line: Really?

title: Silent Enemy

line: Why?

title: Silent Enemy

line: He was so weak he could barely get out of bed. For two days all he had was protein concentrate.

line: When you two were growing up he never said, hey, let's go out for pizza, boy, I'd love some Indian food?

line: I'm figuring that out.

line: When we were training in San Francisco there was a little restaurant on the Embarcadero he liked to go to. They had a specialty, some kind of fish, I think.

title: Silent Enemy

title: Silent Enemy

line: I tried to get a message to the Vulcan High Command, but it didn't go through. If it had, we'd be expecting a Surak class ship tomorrow, oh so politely offering to help us.

line: Well, the Vulcans would have loved that. Towing the pride of Starfleet back to base.

line: Maybe we should thank our visitors for blowing up the subspace amplifiers. It's holding at point oh five.

line: My crew has managed to do in forty eight hours what would've taken the armory team at Jupiter Station at least a week. To say that I'm proud of them would be an understatement. We're preparing our first test. Everybody has their fingers crossed, including me.

line: Not even a microbe? I don't want to blow up something that could evolve into a sentient species in a couple of billion years.

line: Well, what are you suggesting? We choose one species over the other?

title: Dear Doctor
line: All I'm saying is that we let nature make the choice.

title: Dear Doctor
line: The hell with nature. You're a doctor. You have a moral obligation to help people who are suffering.

title: Dear Doctor
line: I'm also a scientist, and I'm obligated to consider the larger issues. Thirty five thousand years ago, your species co-existed with other humanoids. Isn't that correct?

title: Dear Doctor
line: Go ahead.

title: Dear Doctor
line: What if an alien race had interfered and given the Neanderthals an evolutionary advantage? Fortunately for you, they didn't.

title: Dear Doctor
line: I appreciate your perspective on all of this, but we're talking about something that might happen. Might happen thousands of years from now. They've asked for our help. I am not prepared to walk away based on a theory.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Evolution is more than a theory. It is a fundamental scientific principle. Forgive me for saying so, but I believe your compassion for these people is affecting your judgment.

title: Dear Doctor
line: My compassion guides my judgment.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Captain.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Can you find a cure? Doctor?

title: Dear Doctor
line: I already have.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Two days ago, when we first diskovered the alien shuttle, I had no idea that I'd be facing a dilemma of this magnitude. For the first time, I find myself in conflict with my Captain. But he is my Captain and he's placed a great deal of trust in me. I believe I owe him the same. I only hope that he is willing to look beyond his sympathy for these poor people.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Doctor.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Captain.

title: Dear Doctor
line: I'm going down to the Valakian hospital.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Sir, it would go against all my principles if I didn't ask you to reconsider what I

title: Dear Doctor
line: I have reconsidered. I spent the whole night reconsidering, and what I've decided goes against all my principles. Someday my people are going to come up with some sort of a doctrine, something that tells us what we can and can't do out here, should and shouldn't do. But until somebody tells me that they've drafted that directive I'm going to have to remind myself every day that we didn't come out here to play God.

title: Dear Doctor
line: I'd like to think, Doctor Lucas, that if I'd had the chance to talk to you face to face you'd have never let me even consider withholding my findings from the Captain. But I'm ashamed to say that I almost did just that.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Phlox tells me this medicine will help ease the symptoms for a decade, maybe more. A lot can happen in that time. I wouldn't be surprised if you developed a cure on your own.

title: Dear Doctor
line: And if we don't? With a warp capable starship, our chances would be greatly improved.

title: Dear Doctor
line: I'm sorry.

title: Dear Doctor
line: This will give you detailed instructions on how to synthesize more of the medicine.

title: Dear Doctor
line: We appreciate everything you've done.

title: Dear Doctor
line: If I hadn't trusted him to make the right choice I'd have been no better than the Vulcan diplomats who held your species back because they felt you couldn't make proper decisions on your own.

title: Dear Doctor
line: I came very close to misjudging Jonathan Archer, but this incident has helped me gain a new respect for him. Happiness and health to you, Doctor. Your dedicated colleague, Phlox.

title: Dear Doctor
line: You wanted to see me?

title: Dear Doctor
line: Please.

title: Dear Doctor
line: For Doctor Lucas.

title: Dear Doctor
line: It'll go out first thing in the morning. Everything all right?

title: Dear Doctor
line: Fine, fine. The past few days have been taxing.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Want my advice? Get out of Sickbay.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Yes. Perhaps you're right.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Good night.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Good night. Phlox to Crewman Cutler.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Go ahead.

title: Dear Doctor
line: I, er, know it's short notice, but I was wondering if you might like to join me for a little snack in the Mess hall. I could use a friend right about now.

title: Dear Doctor
line: Ten minutes?

title: Dear Doctor
line: Thank you. Sweet dreams.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: The loss to the Vulcan people is incalculable. P'Jem was one of our most revered sanctuaries.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Ambassador, we are very sorry for your loss, but with all due respect the High Command has to take some responsibility. You were using the monastery as a surveillance station.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We were observing a dangerous and aggressive neighbor. The Andorians wouldn't have found the station if your people hadn't interfered. They've been in space for six months and they've already destabilized an entire sector.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I'm afraid I can't agree with that, Ambassador. This was a volatile situation long before Starfleet got involved. Perhaps if you'd been a little more open with us, this tragedy might have been avoided.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We warned you something like this would happen. He's too impulsive. Captain Gardner would have made a far more suitable commanding officer.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: The Vulcan Consulate doesn't make command assignments here.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: There was a time when your people sought our guidance. I regret that time has passed. I've been recalled to Vulcan for consultation. In the meantime, our joint fleet operations have been suspended.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Yes, Admiral?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Get me Captain Archer.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Aye sir.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I noticed we changed course overnight.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I found a new system in the Vulcan database. Coridan. They're only a few light years away so I thought we'd take a look.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Inhabited?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Just over three billion humanoids. Apparently, the Vulcans have a mining agreement with them. I had Hoshi send a message to their Chancellor and she invited us to visit their capital city.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Then I'll start shining my boots.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I think I'll just take Hoshi, this time. The Chancellor asked me to limit the number of people I bring down until they get to know us better.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Oh.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: It's really too bad. According to the database, they've got the largest starship construction yards in the sector. They're supposed to have ships that can run circles around the Vulcans.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Better than six five?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: They say some Coridan ships have reached warp seven, but that's just a rumor.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Warp seven?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: You should lend Hoshi your camera. I'll be sure she takes lots of pictures.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: You had me going there for a minute.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: You're just too easy a target.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: So you're taking me, right?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Bridge to Captain Archer.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Go ahead.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I'm receiving a transmission from Starfleet Command. It's Admiral Forrest, sir.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Was anyone killed?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: The Andorians gave the monks three hours before they started their bombardment. Fortunately, they all got out in time.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: How are the Vulcans taking this?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Not well.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I can't really blame the Andorians for reacting this way.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Jon.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: If the roles were reversed the Vulcans might have done the same thing.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: The Vulcans may have good reason for keeping an eye on them. I've seen the reports. These Andorian commandos are a dangerous group.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: That's the same crap the Vulcans used to say about us.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Jon, you're doing a lot of good work, but you've got to be more careful. Earth can't be getting involved in inter-species conflicts.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I understand.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I'm afraid I've got some more bad news.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Come in. Have a seat.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I just spoke with Admiral Forrest. There's no easy way to say this. The Andorians destroyed the sanctuary at P'Jem.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Were there any survivors?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Fortunately, the monks and the intelligence operatives were given advance warning. They're fine.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Was there time to remove any of the relics?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I don't know. The High Command believes we're to blame for this. They're sending a ship to take you back to Vulcan. It'll be here in two days.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I won't have time to complete my scans of this sector. I'll ask Ensign Mayweather to finish them.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Maybe I wasn't clear. This isn't a temporary transfer. They're reassigning you.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I understand the situation, Captain. I'm certain the High Command will find you a suitable replacement.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Am I the only one who has a problem with this? Because you seem perfectly fine.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: My assignment to the Enterprise was only supposed to last eight days. It was unrealistic to expect it to continue indefinitely.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: The High Command is looking for a scapegoat, someone to blame. They can't punish me so they're taking it out on my science officer. Sounds like an emotional reaction, if you ask me.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I am largely responsible for what happened.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Don't give yourself too much credit. I was the one who found P'Jem in the database, and I led the landing party. I want you to know I'm filing a protest with the High Command.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: That won't make any difference.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: You don't know that.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Captain, I was assigned to Enterprise not simply as an observer, but to represent the interests of the Vulcan people. It's clear in the eyes of my superiors I haven't done that.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: They have no right to do this to you. You're a part of my crew.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: For another forty eight hours. Was there anything else?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: No.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: This is just another part of the joke, right?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Sorry, Trip, but I've got to take T'Pol on this one. I need to spend some time with her alone.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Now I know you're pulling my leg.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: T'Pol's being transferred. A Vulcan ship's on its way to take her back.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: What?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Meet me for lunch. I'll fill you in.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: May I? I just heard about your transfer. I'm sorry you'll be leaving us. I'm sure you'll excel at whatever new assignment you're given.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I haven't received another assignment.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I assumed you were being promoted.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: My superiors believe that I'm responsible for the destruction of the P'Jem sanctuary.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Do you agree with their assessment?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: It's the logical conclusion.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I'm certain the High Command would reconsider your transfer if they knew everything you've done for this crew. You realize you're not the first Vulcan officer to be posted aboard a human starship. The High Command has tried this before but none of the others lasted more than a few weeks. They found their crewmates too chaotic and unpredictable. But you've been here more than six months and you haven't merely tolerated this crew, you've become part of it. Isn't it logical to take pride in that accomplishment?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Pride is a human indulgence.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I suppose it is. Oh, I have it on good authority that several crewmembers are planning a gathering in your honor. I believe it's called a going-away party. I'd keep on alert if I were you.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: So, what do you know about Coridan?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: There are three billion inhabitants, mostly concentrated in several cities in the equatorial region.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I wasn't asking for the statistics. Your people have been coming here for decades. You must know something about their culture, the kinds of food they eat, what they do for fun.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: The Vulcan database doesn't contain that information.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Of course not.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I am uncertain why I was chosen for this mission.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: These people have never seen humans before. It makes sense for someone with a familiar face to make the introductions.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I have a lot of work to complete before the Vulcan ship arrives.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Don't worry, I'll get you back in plenty of time. I just thought you might enjoy one final mission with your Captain. Or maybe I should just take you back to Enterprise.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We're only a few minutes from the capital. Returning to the ship now would be a waste of fuel.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Enterprise to Captain Archer.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Go ahead, Trip.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We're reading a ship closing on you, fast.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I got it.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Some kind of fixed wing aircraft.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Did the Chancellor say anything about sending an escort?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I don't think they're an escort.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Alien vessel. Reduce to one quarter power and adjust heading to three one seven mark five.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I'm taking evasive action. Bring the plasma weapons online.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Ready.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Fire.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Houdini could get out of this.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Perhaps you should invite him on your next mission.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Harry Houdini was a magician, an escape artist. He was famous for being able to free himself from any kind of restraint. Rope, chains, anything.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: That seems unlikely.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: That's why he was called a magician. Some people say he was double-jointed. I don't suppose Vulcans are double-jointed.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Unfortunately not.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: A Vulcan. What brings you to Coridan?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: If you want answers, talk to me.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: You're her superior?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: That's right.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I don't recognize your species.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I'm human, from the planet Earth.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Never heard of Vulcans taking orders from anyone.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: There's been a misunderstanding. We're here at the invitation of your Chancellor.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: She's not my Chancellor. That government is kept in power by the Vulcans. If you're with them, you're on the wrong side.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: What kind of weapon is this? If you won't tell me

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: It's a phase pistol.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We'll put these to good use. I'm curious about your starship. What can you tell me about it?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Our protein resequencer can make chicken sandwiches.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Stop! He's not a tactical officer. He's the ship's steward. We're here to prepare a banquet for your Chancellor.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Your people have a reputation for truthfulness. You wouldn't be lying to me, would you, Vulcan? Now I understand. You're the Captain, aren't you?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Perhaps.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Whoever you are, you picked the wrong time for a visit.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: A steward?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We believe your shuttle was forced down by members of a radical faction, but since the attack took place outside our sensor grid, your officers won't be easy to find.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: You didn't tell us about any factions.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: They're a small group. We had no idea they were capable of an attack like this. But be assured, Commander, your people are almost certainly still alive.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Almost certainly?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: The radicals will want something in exchange for the hostages. They always do. Side arms, dicobalt explosives. It's important that you don't give them anything.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Is this how you protect your visitors?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: You might have told us about your little war before you invited us down.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We're not at war, Commander. This is an isolated incident.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I don't care what you call it. We just want to know where are people are.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We are doing everything in our power to find them.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We're not going to sit on our hands and wait for a ransom note. Start scanning for human and Vulcan biosigns.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: There are billions of people down there. It could take days.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: It might be easier to locate the shuttlepod.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I'll try, but if the pod's been powered down it's almost impossible to pick up its signature.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We've got to start somewhere.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Ready?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Yes.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Go.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Easy.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Come on. Go.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I think we got a little higher that time.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Only a few centimeters.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: That's not frustration I hear in your voice.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: No.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Good. Let's try it again. One, two, three.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Ready?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Yes.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Go.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I think these are starting to come loose. How about yours?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Slightly. If we can turn around, face each other.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We might be able to untie these knots. You'd think the Vulcan database might have mentioned these people were fighting a civil war.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: The database is accurate. The Coridan government doesn't view this as a civil war.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I imagine your people are going to want their database back, too. Well, they can have it.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Can you reach the knot?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I believe so. Without the database you wouldn't have found this planet, or P'Jem.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: You're not responsible for what happened. You didn't have any idea that your people had installled a listening post, or that there were Andorian commandos there.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Enterprise had no good reason to visit a Vulcan sanctuary. I had the opportunity to protest but I chose not to.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: It's clear that living among humans has caused my reasoning to become compromised.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I think I understand. You're running away because you're afraid to become one of us.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I am not running away.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Then why aren't you fighting this transfer?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Your people took something away from my father that meant a lot to him. They're not going to do the same thing to me.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Go get his weapon.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Stop!

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: It's definitely a ditanium signature about four kilometers outside the capital.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: It's practically under their noses.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: From what we can tell, the entire capital is surrounded by a shanty town. There are almost as many biosigns on the outskirts as there are inside the city.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Looks like these people have a lot to learn about building a free society. Have you found human or Vulcan biosigns?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Not yet.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: What about the pod's transponder?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: They must have switched it off. Sir, I've got a rescue team standing by in the launch bay.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Hold on, Malcolm. We don't even know if this is our pod. I don't want to go down and find it's some alien tractor.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: It's our shuttlepod. I'm certain of it. All I'm suggesting is we go down and have a look around.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Sir, we're being hailed. Audio only.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Who is it?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I can't tell.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Put them through.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Is this Enterprise?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Yes. And you are?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We're holding your Captain and your steward. In exchange for their safe return we want forty of your phase weapons, the same type we found aboard your shuttle. You'll be hailed at this time tomorrow.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Wait, let me talk to the Captain.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I'm sure you wouldn't want any harm to come to her. We'll rely on your full compliance.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Hello?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: They've cut transmission.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Were you able to trace it?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: They were using a triaxilating signal.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: They called the Captain 'her'. Are we sure they've got the right hostages?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: At least it sounds like they're still alive.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: For how long? We don't have forty phase pistols, we've got fifteen, and even if we give them to these people there's no guarantee they'll keep their word. We know where the shuttle is. We have to send a team down now while we still have the element of surprise.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We're getting another transmission.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Probably thought of something else they want.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: It's not from the planet. It's coming from a Vulcan ship, the Ni'Var.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Put it up.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Where's Captain Archer?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: He's not here right now. Can I help you?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Inform him that we'll be arriving within the hour.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: You guys made great time. We weren't expecting you until tomorrow.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: You obviously made an error in your calculations. Please have Sub-commander T'Pol ready to depart when we arrive.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We've got a bit of a problem. She's not here either. She and the Captain were on their way to the capital city when they were kidnapped.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: How convenient.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I'm telling you, they were kidnapped.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: How do you know this?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Maybe the ransom demand we just received gave us a clue. They threatened to kill them both if we didn't give them what they want.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: It would be irrational to kill the hostages. They would lose their negotiating position.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Maybe we're not dealing with the most rational people down there, did you consider that?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Since the situation involves a Vulcan officer, we will take over the investigation. It would be best if you refrained from any foolish endeavors.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: What the hell's that supposed

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I'm getting real sick of being cut off.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Your vessel is ill-equipped to mount a rescue mission. You would most likely become captives yourselves. My team will penetrate their base of operations.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: What does that mean?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Sounds to me like you're planning an assault.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Did it ever occur to you that that could get the Captain and T'Pol killed?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We've dealt with this sort of threat in the past. Swift, decisive action is the logical response.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: You're awfully trigger-happy for someone who's repressed his emotions.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: They've threatened the life of a Vulcan officer. We must diskourage any such incidents in the future.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: This isn't your planet. Maybe the Coridan government has something to say about this.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I've already been in contact with the Chancellor. She's given me full authority to implement this action.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: You don't really care what happens to them, do you? You probably wouldn't mind if they got caught in the crossfire. You'd consider it payback for what happened at P'Jem.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: It is not Vulcan policy to negotiate with terrorists.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Not even if it saves lives?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Any data you may have on the location of your Captain and the Sub-Commander would be useful.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Sorry, we don't have anything.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Warm up the shuttlepod.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: We can't eat like this.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Friendly.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Can you pick up yours?

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: No.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: Dig in, Sub-commander. I don't think you'll be able to send this back for some plomeek broth.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: I'm not hungry.

line: Sopek is the senior Vulcan officer in the sector. Naturally, we keep him under close surveillance. We've been monitoring all Vulcan transmissions and ship deployments since the incident at P'Jem. We know they're preparing for a war against us.

line: I'm no fan of the Vulcans, but they're not warmongers.

line: There's already a war going on, and the Vulcans are in the middle of it. Several rebel factions here are working to overthrow their government, a corrupt government that has very close ties to your peace loving, logical friends.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: The hostage-takers have no plans to return your Captain or the female. Once you deliver the weapons, they'll be killed. Fortunately for you, we have a relationship with the down-trodden here.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: You tried to kill us last time we met. Why are you trying to help us now?

line: I haven't slept well since our encounter at the Vulcan sanctuary. I don't like being indebted to anyone, least of all your Captain.

title: Shadows of P'Jem

title: Shadows of P'Jem

line: Your people are being held here. These are barracks for the guards.

line: At least four inside the compound, two more up on the wall here, and two guards outside the gate. All armed with particle weapons.

title: Shadows of P'Jem

line: Not exactly. We met up with some old friends down here. Andorians. Apparently, one of them thinks he owes you a favor.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: He couldn't have picked a better time.

title: Shadows of P'Jem
line: One of the people guarding you is working with them. When he unties you, head for the gate. It's about twenty meters from the building you're in. Until he shows up, just sit tight.

line: I know how you must feel. She saved my life once too. She can be a real pain in the ass. Stubborn, arrogant. Sometimes she makes me angry enough, I want to shove her out an airlock. title: Shadows of P'Jem

line: I'm not asking anyone to pin a medal on her. All I'm asking is that she be given a second chance. title: Shadows of P'Jem

Maybe it's time I stopped being so afraid of change. Will you help me take my daughter home?

title: Oasis
line: We'll stay as long as it takes to get your ship flying.

title: Oasis
line: Thank you, Captain, but all we need are these components. I've got my own crew to do the work some of them are pretty fair engineers. I saw to that.

title: Oasis
line: How's it going?

title: Oasis
line: Good. We're about to start realigning the antimatter injectors.

title: Oasis
line: That was fast.

title: Oasis
line: What's that?

title: Oasis
line: It's a protein resequencer. I figured you must be tired of eating the same food all the time. I programd it for making ice-cream. Only five flavors, but they're good ones.

title: Oasis
line: Rocky Road?

title: Oasis
line: You didn't think I'd send you off without Rocky Road.

title: Oasis
line: Thank you.

title: Oasis
line: Are you sure you don't want us to stay for a while, lend a hand?

title: Oasis
line: You've got a lot more places to go.

title: Oasis
line: So do you.

title: Oasis
line: Maybe I'll see you out there.

title: Oasis
line: I'd like that.

title: Detained
line: Captain? Sir?

title: Detained
line: How many?

title: Detained
line: I saw at least thirty. This place is pretty big. There could be more.

title: Detained
line: Any idea who attacked the shuttle?

title: Detained
line: I didn't exactly have time to get a good look.

title: Detained
line: The energy readings we got from the other side of that moon could have come from a Helix.

title: Detained
line: There's a wall about five meters high. It's looks like it surrounds this entire building. I see something that might be a guard tower but I can't be sure.

title: Detained
line: Any people?

title: Detained
line: No, sir.

title: Detained
line: You up for another walk?

title: Detained
line: You're the new arrivals.

title: Detained
line: Why are we here?

title: Detained
line: Why are any of us here?

title: Detained
line: Follow me.

title: Detained
line: Thank you, Major. Please, sit down.

title: Detained
line: I can understand why you're upset. No doubt you've had a difficult afternoon.

title: Detained
line: To say the least.

title: Detained
line: I meant to speak to you earlier, but I had some urgent business to attend to. I apologize. We don't see many starship captains here. Jonathan Archer.

title: Detained
line: That's right.

title: Detained
line: You must be Travis Mayweather.

title: Detained
line: And you are?

title: Detained
line: I am Colonel Grat.

title: Detained
line: I take it you're the man in charge.

title: Detained
line: I took the liberty to examine the database in your shuttlecraft, so I know that you're from a planet called Earth and that you serve on a vessel called Enterprise. What I don't know is what you were doing within our military zone.

title: Detained
line: Military zone?

title: Detained
line: You entered orbit of our second moon. You must have detected it.

title: Detained
line: We picked up some unusual energy readings but we had no idea where they were coming from. We were simply curious.

title: Detained
line: Your curiosity almost got you killed. Fortunately, our patrol ship didn't vaporize your shuttlecraft.

title: Detained
line: You might think about putting up a 'no trespassing' sign.

title: Detained
line: I'll pass that along.

title: Detained
line: Where are we now?

title: Detained
line: This is a detention complex. It's several light years from where we found you.

title: Detained
line: Does everyone that violates your territory get thrown into a place like this?

title: Detained
line: We're at war with a species that can mimic the appearance of almost any humanoid. We had to make certain that you weren't infiltrators.

title: Detained
line: If you're worried we're Suliban, trust me, we're not.

title: Detained
line: I know. We've already tested your DNA. You're familiar with the Cabal?

title: Detained
line: Unfortunately.

title: Detained
line: Then you must know about their genetic enhancements and how dangerous they can be.

title: Detained
line: Firsthand.

title: Detained
line: I hope you didn't suffer too many casualties.

title: Detained
line: We've been lucky so far. We're eager to get back to Enterprise. If you'll take us to our shuttlepod, we'll be on our way.

title: Detained
line: I'm afraid I don't have the authority to release you. We have very strict regulations. You'll have to appear before a magistrate on Tandar Prime. But the hearing should be brief. I'll explain that this was just an innocent misunderstanding.

title: Detained
line: When's this hearing?

title: Detained
line: A transport will be here in three days.

title: Detained
line: Three days?

title: Detained
line: I wish I could offer you more comfortable accommodations. Unfortunately, this detention complex is overcrowded at the moment. I would advise you to keep to yourselves. If the Suliban give you any trouble, simply tell one of the guards.

title: Detained
line: I'd like to contact my ship, let them know we're all right.

title: Detained
line: I can't permit that, Captain.

title: Detained
line: Regulations?

title: Detained
line: But I will call them personally and explain the situation.

title: Detained
line: Escort these gentlemen back to their quarters. Make sure they get a proper meal. I'm sorry we couldn't have met under better circumstances.

title: Detained
line: So am I.

title: Detained
line: They call this a proper meal? I should save it for Commander Tucker. It'd make a good valve sealant.

title: Detained
line: Why don't you get some sleep. I'll take the first watch.

title: Detained
line: This thing doesn't hold much.

title: Detained
line: I'll be right back.

title: Detained
line: How about waiting your turn?

title: Detained
line: I can't believe you'd do this to a child.

title: Detained
line: Do what?

title: Detained
line: She's a little young to be a member of the Cabal.

title: Detained
line: You don't know what you're talking about.

title: Detained
line: I know that you're given genetic tricks as payment. What are they giving her?

title: Detained
line: I don't know who you are, but you're wrong about us.

title: Detained
line: Is that so?

title: Detained
line: We're not genetically enhanced and we're not members of the Cabal.

title: Detained
line: If that's true, then what are you doing here?

title: Detained
line: Didn't Colonel Grat tell you? We're dangerous. All Suliban are dangerous.

title: Detained
line: It's past curfew.

title: Detained
line: We were just on our way back.

title: Detained
line: Sorry, Danik. It's the second time this week.

title: Detained
line: Klev, please.

title: Detained
line: It's only for one night.

title: Detained
line: It's my fault. I'm the one who kept them here.

title: Detained
line: Get back to your cell.

title: Detained
line: Where are you taking him?

title: Detained
line: Isolation. Unless you want to join him, do as I say.

title: Detained
line: Will you make sure she gets back? I'll see you in the morning. Don't worry.

title: Detained
line: I'd like to speak with them.

title: Detained
line: I'm sorry, but regulations forbid that. There's nothing to be concerned about. They've been placed in comfortable quarters and they're perfectly safe.

title: Detained
line: If it's all the same to you, I'd rather hear that from the Captain.

title: Detained
line: I'm afraid that's not possible.

title: Detained
line: May we attend the hearing?

title: Detained
line: Of course.

title: Detained
line: Will they be given legal representation?

title: Detained
line: They're also free to choose their own counsel. When you arrive at Tandar Prime you'll be contacted by the Central Magistrate's Office.

title: Detained
line: We'll need the coordinates.

title: Detained
line: I'm sending them now.

title: Detained
line: Thank you, Colonel.

title: Detained
line: Good luck to you.

title: Detained
line: Hoshi?

title: Detained
line: I can't trace the signal. He must have scrambled the carrier wave.

title: Detained
line: Keep at it.

title: Detained
line: What are you suggesting we do, mount a rescue?

title: Detained
line: The thought crossed my mind.

title: Detained
line: It would be a mistake to provoke the Tandarans any further.

title: Detained
line: So, we just sit on our hands.

title: Detained
line: The hearing's in three days.

title: Detained
line: And what if they're found guilty, sentenced to thirty years in prison?

title: Detained
line: That's unlikely. If you want to explore alien cultures you'll need to learn to respect their laws. If Captain Archer were here, I'm sure he'd agree. If you'd like, I'll contact the Vulcan High Command. They might be willing to send an arbitrator.

title: Detained
line: A Vulcan lawyer? They'd be better off getting the electric chair.

title: Detained
line: Electric chair?

title: Detained
line: Never mind.

title: Detained
line: Set a course for Tandar Prime.

title: Detained
line: Hello again. I hope isolation wasn't too rough.

title: Detained
line: It gets very cold in there at night. Sometimes I wish I was genetically enhanced. If you've come to apologize, don't. It was just a misunderstanding.

title: Detained
line: Actually, I was hoping to find out what's going on around here.

title: Detained
line: Maybe you should talk to one of the Tandarans.

title: Detained
line: I spoke to Colonel Grat, but I get the feeling he's not telling me the whole story. Archer. My name is Jonathan Archer.

title: Detained
line: More?

title: Detained
line: I've had plenty, thank you. It was very good.

title: Detained
line: You look like Tandarans.

title: Detained
line: Why don't you go and find your friends? And don't forget curfew.

title: Detained
line: I won't.

title: Detained
line: We're not criminals, Captain, and we're not soldiers. The only thing we're guilty of is being Suliban.

title: Detained
line: They must have tested your DNA, figured out that you haven't been genetically altered.

title: Detained
line: As far as they're concerned, that doesn't mean anything. You believed I was a member of the Cabal, didn't you? Didn't you?

title: Detained
line: Yes, I did.

title: Detained
line: All that seems to matter is the way we look. 'Be careful of their wicked smiles, their shining yellow eyes. At night, they'll squeeze right through your door and everybody dies.' The Tandaran children used to tease my daughter with that nursery rhyme. At least here, she doesn't have to hear it anymore.

title: Detained
line: This is an internment camp.

title: Detained
line: Detention Complex twenty six. I've heard it's one of their nicer ones.

title: Detained
line: Why did this happen?

title: Detained
line: The Cabal began their attacks eight years ago. It wasn't long before the Tandarans started to question the loyalty of all Suliban living in their territory. We were rounded up, relocated as they like to say. They told us it was only temporary. It was for our own safety. 'Once the Cabal has been destroyed, you will be free to go back to your homes.' We're still waiting. There are eighty nine of us here. Thousands more in other camps. Everyone of us used to be citizens on worlds in the Tandar Sector. Did you know that I was born in the same town as one of the guards? Major Klev. I was friends with his brother when we were growing up.

title: Detained
line: What about the government on the Suliban homeworld? Don't they have something to say about this?

title: Detained
line: I'm sure they would if they still existed. Our homeworld became uninhabitable three hundred years ago. Most Suliban are nomadic, but some of us have assimilated into other cultures. My grandfather made the unfortunate decision to settle on Tandar Prime. Yes?

title: Detained
line: What are they doing here?

title: Detained
line: It's all right. I asked them.

title: Detained
line: This came today. What species are you?

title: Detained
line: We're human.

title: Detained
line: Never heard of them.

title: Detained
line: Sajen, you're being rude.

title: Detained
line: Bad news?

title: Detained
line: It's my wife. We were separated during the relocation. She's in one of the other camps. Her transfer was rejected again. She tried to appeal their decision, but as usual, they wouldn't listen.

title: Detained
line: I'm sorry.

title: Detained
line: Midday inspection. Try to look your best.

title: Detained
line: Thank you for lunch.

title: Detained
line: Thank you for listening.

title: Detained
line: Why did you bring them here?

title: Detained
line: Maybe I was tired of talking to you.

title: Detained
line: They could be working with Grat.

title: Detained
line: Hey!

title: Detained
line: Colonel Grat wants to see you.

title: Detained
line: Just him.

title: Detained
line: I understand you were out after curfew last night, arguing with a Suliban.

title: Detained
line: It was just a misunderstanding.

title: Detained
line: You should have my advice, Captain.

title: Detained
line: I know, I know. it's a big problem with me. I'm just too damn curious. Whenever I meet new people I can't resist trying to get to know them. I'm certainly getting to know a lot about the Suliban around here.

title: Detained
line: I admire your spirit of exploration, but in this case it could get you into trouble. Keep to yourself.

title: Detained
line: I'll do my best. Unless you have any more advice?

title: Detained
line: No, but I do have a question. Have you ever been to Oklahoma? I guess you could say I'm a curious man myself. After you mentioned that you were familiar with the Cabal I decided to speak with our intelligence agency. They've uncovered some interesting facts. Apparently two Suliban soldiers crash-landed near a town called Broken Bow, Oklahoma. They were chasing a Klingon, of all things. I was wondering if you could provide some insight into what they were doing there.

title: Detained
line: I wouldn't know. You'd have to talk to my superiors.

title: Detained
line: Oh, I think you know a great deal. Enterprise took the Klingon back to his homeworld. Isn't that right? Rigel Ten. You made a detour there. From what I'm told, you contacted a woman named Sarin. You remember her? Well, I'll remind you. She was the head of a Suliban resistance cell. She was killed by the Cabal in a firefight at the trade complex. Several of our people saw you there, Captain. I believe you were injured, a shot in the leg. Do I have to ask your superiors about that as well?

title: Detained
line: What exactly do you want?

title: Detained
line: Information. What do you know about the Cabal? What genetic enhancements you've seen, Helix deployments. Who's giving them their orders?

title: Detained
line: You've got plenty of Suliban here. Why not ask them?

title: Detained
line: We both know they wouldn't be very helpful.

title: Detained
line: Then why are they in prison?

title: Detained
line: That's a diskussion for another time.

title: Detained
line: There are families here, children. One man hasn't seen his wife in years.

title: Detained
line: Tell me what you know.

title: Detained
line: They don't deserve this kind of treatment.

title: Detained
line: They're here for their own protection.

title: Detained
line: Oh, really?

title: Detained
line: The last thing we wanted to do was build these detention centers, but we had no choice. When the Cabal began their activities there was a great deal of fear among the Tandarans. There were instances of violence. Fourteen innocent Suliban were killed in one day alone. We had to find a way to keep them out of danger.

title: Detained
line: Then why not just let them find another place to live?

title: Detained
line: They wouldn't get very far. It's ironic, but once they're out of Tandaran territory the Cabal will hunt them down and turn them all into soldiers. They're better off here.

title: Detained
line: I've met a few Suliban who disagree.

title: Detained
line: One of the Cabal leaders is a man named Silik. He infiltrated your vessel approximately three months ago posing as a Borothan pilgrim. What did he want? Did he speak of the Temporal Cold War? Answer me!

title: Detained
line: This conversation is taking longer than I expected. I'd hate to see you miss that transport tomorrow morning. The next one won't arrive for another sixty days.

title: Detained
line: I'm afraid the hearing's been postponed.

title: Detained
line: Why?

title: Detained
line: The magistrate assigned to their case is in the middle of a very complex proceeding and it's taking more time than he expected.

title: Detained
line: How much longer are they going to have to wait?

title: Detained
line: Hopefully not more than a few days. If you stay on course for Tandar Prime I'll arrange for an ambassador to show you our capital city when you arrive.

title: Detained
line: We're not interested in a tour. We just want our people back.

title: Detained
line: I'm doing everything I can. Try to be patient. You'll hear from me soon.

title: Detained
line: I've isolated their carrier frequency. Do you see it?

title: Detained
line: I'm tracing it now. Bearing one seven eight mark twelve.

title: Detained
line: How far?

title: Detained
line: Five point two light years.

title: Detained
line: All I'm saying is we go take a look for ourselves, make sure they're okay.

title: Detained
line: Proceed.

title: Detained
line: Most of the people we meet have been pretty eager to get to know us but we've had our share of unfortunate encounters. I guess you could say this is one of them.

title: Detained
line: I've lived with Tandarans all my life. They're decent people, for the most part.

title: Detained
line: What about you? What did you do before you ended up here?

title: Detained
line: I was director of research at an engineering institute. It's in the Querella Province. You should see it, assuming your hearing goes well.

title: Detained
line: I've got a feeling we could be here for awhile.

title: Detained
line: Why not tell Grat what you know, get yourself out of here.

title: Detained
line: I don't like being strong-armed, and I don't like what he's doing to you and the others. Has anyone every tried to get out of here?

title: Detained
line: You mean escape? A couple of years ago three men pried open one of the security grates. They tried to get to the docking bay.

title: Detained
line: Docking bay?

title: Detained
line: Yes. It's about a hundred meters away. It's where they keep Suliban ships they've impounded.

title: Detained
line: What happened?

title: Detained
line: Oh, they managed to get inside but before they could reach a vessel all three of them were killed. Colonel Grat made a ridiculous claim that they were armed.

title: Detained
line: They might have succeeded with a little help from the outside. It won't be long before Enterprise comes looking for Mayweather and me.

title: Detained
line: I appreciate the offer, Captain, but I doubt many people here would be willing to take the risk.

title: Detained
line: Have you asked them? How many ships are in that docking bay?

title: Detained
line: Writing a letter?

title: Detained
line: It's a journal.

title: Detained
line: Could be valuable someday. People will want to know what happened here.

title: Detained
line: I doubt anyone will ever read this.

title: Detained
line: Then why are you writing it?

title: Detained
line: Why do you care? I see how you look at us. Suliban terrify you. You wouldn't be surprised if I slithered up this wall or turned my face inside out. Cabal, Suliban, it's all the same to you.

title: Detained
line: That's not true.

title: Detained
line: What took you so long?

title: Detained
line: Are you all right?

title: Detained
line: More or less.

title: Detained
line: We're picking up

title: Detained
line: Suliban bio-signs.

title: Detained
line: It's not what you think. Are you sure this is a secure frequency?

title: Detained
line: I'm triaxilating the signal, sir. If we were in the middle of Starfleet headquarters no one would pick it up.

title: Detained
line: Good. Where are you?

title: Detained
line: In orbit. It won't be long before we're detected.

title: Detained
line: I'm getting a transporter lock on you now, Captain.

title: Detained
line: Just say the word and we'll bring you both home.

title: Detained
line: Hang on, Trip. We're not ready to leave just yet.

title: Detained
line: Those Suliban you detected are prisoners too, but they're no more guilty than we are.

title: Detained
line: I want to help them get out of here.

title: Detained
line: Captain?

title: Detained
line: Have you ever heard of Manzanar, Sub-Commander?

title: Detained
line: I'm not familiar with that planet.

title: Detained
line: It's not a planet. It was an internment camp

title: Detained
line: On Earth during the Second World War. Japanese-American citizens were imprisoned there even though they didn't do anything wrong. The same thing's happening here.

title: Detained
line: I thought you decided not to interfere with other cultures.

title: Detained
line: In this case, I'm making an exception.

title: Detained
line: Understood?

title: Detained
line: Yes, Captain.

title: Detained
line: I've met a Suliban who knows this camp inside and out. We've been working on a plan but we're going to need your help.

title: Detained
line: We'll need a few of your people. Anyone who's had experience with particle weapons.

title: Detained
line: We won't make it ten meters outside the complex before we're shot, like the others.

title: Detained
line: And even if we did get to the ships and managed to lift off, there are patrol vessels in the area.

title: Detained
line: Enterprise can handle them.

title: Detained
line: And once we've made this miraculous escape, where do you expect us to go?

title: Detained
line: All we have to do is get out of Tandaran territory. After that, we can set a course for the Niburon colonies. I know some people there. They might be willing to help us.

title: Detained
line: It's too dangerous.

title: Detained
line: Would you rather spend the rest of your life in prison?

title: Detained
line: You're placing a lot of trust in people you've only known for three days. For all we know they've been planted here to stage this revolt so Grat would finally have a reason to kill all of us.

title: Detained
line: We're not working for the Tandarans.

title: Detained
line: Think of your daughter. Are you willing to risk her life, too?

title: Detained
line: We're getting out of here, Sajen.

title: Detained
line: I'm not going to help you plan our suicide.

title: Detained
line: I hope the others were more enthusiastic.

title: Detained
line: This is the wall that I was telling you about. It's only forty meters from the docking bay.

title: Detained
line: Have you had a chance to reconsider? I'm willing to compromise, Captain. Just tell me what you know about Silik.

title: Detained
line: Well, he's about this tall, a little on the scrawny side, bad teeth.

title: Detained
line: If you're unwilling to diskuss the Suliban, maybe you can help me with something else. We detected some unusual energy readings last night. At first we thought it was random interference, but after examining the readings more closely we diskovered they were coming from your quarters.

title: Detained
line: You should check your sensors. They're obviously malfunctioning.

title: Detained
line: I'm told they're working perfectly.

title: Detained
line: Sorry, Captain.

title: Detained
line: We found this in Ensign Mayweather's pocket but he wouldn't say how it got there. I was hoping you could tell me. Take him to isolation.

title: Detained
line: If I come in low from the east I should be able to evade their proximity sensors.

title: Detained
line: This appears to be a pulse cannon.

title: Detained
line: It'll be my first target.

title: Detained
line: Bridge to Sickbay.

title: Detained
line: Phlox here.

title: Detained
line: What's your status?

title: Detained
line: Finishing as we speak, though I'm not completely happy with the nose.

title: Detained
line: It's almost time.

title: Detained
line: Understood.

title: Detained
line: It's Captain Archer.

title: Detained
line: Put him through. Go ahead, Captain.

title: Detained
line: You seem to be off-course. I thought you were headed for Tandar Prime. What brings you here?

title: Detained
line: Where's Captain Archer?

title: Detained
line: If you're thinking about trying to circumvent our legal system I advise against it.

title: Detained
line: You come any closer to our planet and my patrol ships will open fire.

title: Detained
line: What happened to you?

title: Detained
line: What do you care.

title: Detained
line: Danik's been looking for your Captain. Have you seen him?

title: Detained
line: You might try isolation. Still think we're working with the Tandarans? You know, we could have left this place a long time ago if we hadn't decided to help you.

title: Detained
line: I never asked for your help.

title: Detained
line: Why? Because we're not Suliban? Because we look a little too much like Tandarans? I'll admit, when I first came here it wasn't easy to see past my preconceptions about the Suliban, but I did. Why can't you?

title: Detained
line: We're being hailed. It's him. GRAT [on viewscreen: Check your sensors and you'll see two patrol ships headed toward you.

title: Detained
line: We didn't come here to fight. We came to talk with you.

title: Detained
line: They'll have a weapons lock on your vessel in less than one minute.

title: Detained
line: Do you eat meat, Colonel?

title: Detained
line: What?

title: Detained
line: Our chef is preparing a meal in your honor, and I was curious whether you're vegetarian. I was hoping you'd join me for dinner. It would give us an opportunity to get acquainted.

title: Detained
line: You have forty five seconds to leave orbit.

title: Detained
line: I can't believe you're really going to destroy our vessel over a trivial incident like this. I can tell you're an enlightened man. All I'm asking for is a chance to show you that we're enlightened as well. We're transmitting a copy of Earth's historical database along with the Starfleet charter, and a record of all human contacts with alien species. If you have any doubts about our intentions this material should lay them to rest. Send him the Vulcan database as well. I think you'll find that my people have a great deal in common with you, too.

title: Detained
line: You're jamming our frequencies. Break off your transmission now.

title: Detained
line: What about dinner? Should I set a

title: Detained
line: I'm not going to warn you again. End your transmission and leave orbit.

title: Detained
line: Mister Tucker.

title: Detained
line: It's done.

title: Detained
line: Those patrol ships are closing fast.

title: Detained
line: Get us out of here.

title: Detained
line: Yes?

title: Detained
line: I understand you're looking for a way out of here.

title: Detained
line: Who are you?

title: Detained
line: Don't you recognize me, Travis?

title: Detained
line: Malcolm?

title: Detained
line: In the flesh. Oh, you look worse than I do. What happened?

title: Detained
line: Long story. How'd you get down here?

title: Detained
line: Transporter. I think I'm finally getting used to it.

title: Detained
line: Are you sure you weren't detected?

title: Detained
line: No, thanks to Hoshi. She kept the sensors occupied.

title: Detained
line: Congratulations, Ensign. Your case is about to be dismissed.

title: Detained
line: The isolation block is here. He's in one of these cells.

title: Detained
line: I'll find him.

title: Detained
line: The charges?

title: Detained
line: They're in place. Are you up for this?

title: Detained
line: Nightly inspection.

title: Detained
