line: Yes.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Well, what's it like?

title: Fallen Hero
line: A Minshara class planet with three moons. Its gravity is approximately equal to Earth's sea level.

title: Fallen Hero
line: How's the ocean?

title: Fallen Hero
line: I wouldn't know.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Any good restaurants?

title: Fallen Hero
line: I'm told there are. It's all in the database.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Did you do anything there?

title: Fallen Hero
line: I meditated in an isolation chamber filled with warm alluvial mud.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I imagine that's quite good for the skin. Three ships coming up fast.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Polarize the hull plating. Captain, report to the Bridge.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Our Mazarite friends, sir, and they've brought company.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Why didn't we see them coming?

title: Fallen Hero
line: Our aft sensors are still out of alignment.

title: Fallen Hero
line: They're targeting our engines.

title: Fallen Hero
line: We could drop to impulse, use the phase cannons.

title: Fallen Hero
line: And go three against one? You're familiar with the Mazarites. What's their top speed?

title: Fallen Hero
line: Comparable to Starfleet. I don't believe they've exceeded warp five.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Then let's give them a run for their money. Travis, increase speed to warp four point eight.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Aye, sir. Warp four point eight.

title: Fallen Hero
line: They're matching our speed and accelerating. Warp four point nine.

title: Fallen Hero
line: They're closing to twenty thousand kilometers. Fifteen.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Archer to Engineering.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I was wondering when you were going to call. We're really stoking the boilers down here.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Keep shoveling. We're going to four point nine.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Just in case anyone's keeping track, I believe that'll be a Starfleet record.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Let's celebrate later.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Travis.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Warp four point nine.

title: Fallen Hero
line: They're holding at four point nine, sir.

title: Fallen Hero
line: How far to the rendezvous point?

title: Fallen Hero
line: At this speed, a little over two hours, but I don't think we can hold it that long.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Can we get a message through to the Vulcans?

title: Fallen Hero
line: The Mazarites are still jamming us.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Keep trying. That Vulcan ship better not be late.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Captain, what's our situation?

title: Fallen Hero
line: We're being chased by three Mazarite ships.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Will we reach the Sh'Raan before they can do any more damage?

title: Fallen Hero
line: I'm not sure.

title: Fallen Hero
line: In that case, I need to speak with you.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I have to consider the possibility that this mission will fail.

title: Fallen Hero
line: You still haven't told me what this mission is.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I've been under orders to tell you only what you need to know, but that wasn't the only reason I kept things from you. I didn't trust you. As your Mister Tucker pointed out, I have been around a long time. I remember when news of your people first reached Vulcan. I was fascinated by humanity but worried as well.

title: Fallen Hero
line: You hadn't even met us.

title: Fallen Hero
line: You had just emerged from a global war. The idea that you deemed yourselves ready to join the interstellar community seemed premature.

title: Fallen Hero
line: And a century of good behavior hasn't changed your mind?

title: Fallen Hero
line: The Mazarites pursuing us are criminals. They are members of an organization that's infiltrated all levels of government, making themselves wealthy and powerful at the expense of many innocent victims. Their methods include eliminating anyone who stands in their way.

title: Fallen Hero
line: And that would include you.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Many Mazarites want their government purged of this corruption. They asked the Vulcan consulate to help them expose these criminals.

title: Fallen Hero
line: And that job fell to you?

title: Fallen Hero
line: I have been gathering evidence against them. In three months, I will be called to testify. It was decided that until then I would be safer on Vulcan.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Why couldn't you tell us?

title: Fallen Hero
line: The investigation was considered too sensitive.

title: Fallen Hero
line: And the story of you being recalled in disgrace?

title: Fallen Hero
line: It was hoped that if my reputation were sullied they would not consider me a credible witness, and they might not come after me.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Obviously, it didn't work.

title: Fallen Hero
line: The corruption ran deeper than I thought.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I appreciate you telling me the truth.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I can no longer put you and your crew in danger, Captain. Please drop out of warp. I plan to surrender myself to them.

title: Fallen Hero
line: It hasn't gotten to that yet.

title: Fallen Hero
line: It's the most logical course of action.

title: Fallen Hero
line: If you've learned anything about humans, you'd know we don't always take the most logical course of action.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Captain, report to the Bridge.

title: Fallen Hero
line: They're hailing us.

title: Fallen Hero
line: What's our status?

title: Fallen Hero
line: Holding at warp four point nine, but Commander Tucker doesn't believe we can sustain it for more than another ten minutes.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I don't believe they can either, sir. They're releasing drive plasma to keep their warp coils from overloading.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Open a channel.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Captain. Ambassador.

title: Fallen Hero
line: What do you want?

title: Fallen Hero
line: Just giving you a friendly warning. Are you aware that your engines are overheating?

title: Fallen Hero
line: So are yours.

title: Fallen Hero
line: We have no quarrel with you. Give us the Vulcan and you'll be free to go.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I have a better idea. Why don't you slow down before your engines explode?

title: Fallen Hero
line: Why would you risk the lives of your crew for this criminal?

title: Fallen Hero
line: I've been ordered to deliver her safely to the Vulcans, and that's exactly what I plan to do.

title: Fallen Hero
line: They're increasing speed. Warp four point nine five.

title: Fallen Hero
line: They're re-entering weapons range, sir.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Archer to Engineering.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Please tell me you're ready to slow down.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Sorry Trip, but we need a little more speed.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I don't know how much more I can give you.

title: Fallen Hero
line: It's called a warp five engine.

title: Fallen Hero
line: On paper.

title: Fallen Hero
line: We don't have any choice, Trip.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Aye, sir.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Ambassador. Warp five.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Four point nine three, nine five.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Don't take your eyes off that antimatter stream.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Yes, sir.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Four point nine seven.

title: Fallen Hero
line: They're matching our speed.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Four point nine nine. Warp five.

title: Fallen Hero
line: They're still gaining on us.

title: Fallen Hero
line: How far to the Vulcan ship?

title: Fallen Hero
line: Their jamming signal is disrupting our sensors as well.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Then use their last known position and do the math. Take a guess.

title: Fallen Hero
line: If we could maintain our present speed, approximately fifty three minutes.

title: Fallen Hero
line: The Mazarites will be in firing range long before then.

title: Fallen Hero
line: What if we could get a message through? Tell them to get here as fast as they can.

title: Fallen Hero
line: The Sh'Raan is capable of warp seven. If we could maintain warp five we'd reach them in twelve minutes.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Hoshi, any way you can get a message through the interference?

title: Fallen Hero
line: I don't see how, sir.

title: Fallen Hero
line: There's a diplomatic frequency we sometimes use. It's in a lower subspace band. I doubt the Mazarites are aware of it.

title: Fallen Hero
line: It's been a few years since I did this.

title: Fallen Hero
line: If we do get a message through to the Vulcans, we don't want the Mazarites to see them coming.

title: Fallen Hero
line: We could try deflecting their jamming signal, sir. Use it to blind their sensors as well.

title: Fallen Hero
line: See what you can do.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Aye, sir.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Hoshi?

title: Fallen Hero
line: We may have gotten a message through to them, sir, but I'm not sure.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Wouldn't they respond?

title: Fallen Hero
line: Tucker to the Bridge!

title: Fallen Hero
line: Go ahead.

title: Fallen Hero
line: The port injectors just blew!

title: Fallen Hero
line: We've got to slow down, Captain!

title: Fallen Hero
line: I got it, I got it.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Hoshi?

title: Fallen Hero
line: The comm. just went down, sir.

title: Fallen Hero
line: They're right on top of us.

title: Fallen Hero
line: How long?

title: Fallen Hero
line: Eight minutes.

title: Fallen Hero
line: That's a direct hit to our starboard nacelle.

title: Fallen Hero
line: We're dropping to impulse.

title: Fallen Hero
line: They're hailing us.

title: Fallen Hero
line: How long now?

title: Fallen Hero
line: If they received our message, another ten minutes.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I thought it was down to eight.

title: Fallen Hero
line: That was before we dropped out of warp.

title: Fallen Hero
line: We can't hold off those ships for that long.

title: Fallen Hero
line: You've done your best, Captain, and I thank you for it, but it's time for me to turn myself over to them.

title: Fallen Hero
line: We just need to buy ten more minutes.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Captain.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I want you to go to Sickbay.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Sickbay?

title: Fallen Hero
line: I'll explain later. If there was ever a time to start trusting us, this would be it.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Put him through.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Give us the Vulcan.

title: Fallen Hero
line: You know, I honestly didn't think you'd be able to catch us. Just out of curiosity, how fast do your ships go?

title: Fallen Hero
line: Put her on a shuttle and bring her to our lead vessel.

title: Fallen Hero
line: That could be a problem. Our shuttlebay was damaged, thanks to you. I doubt we could launch a shuttlepod until it's repaired. What, what would you have topped out at? Warp five point five? Warp six? I can't imagine that you can do much more than that. It seemed like your engines were starting to run pretty hot.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Prepare to be boarded.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Malcolm, I'm counting on you. T'Pol.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Okay.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Where is she?

title: Fallen Hero
line: Your last attack blew out systems across half the ship. Power's down in Engineering. A plasma conduit exploded on E deck.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I didn't ask for a damage report. Where is she?

title: Fallen Hero
line: I was getting to that. Her quarters are on E deck. She was no more than ten meters away when the conduit blew.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Her injuries are extensive. Plasma burns, neurological trauma.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I want to see her.

title: Fallen Hero
line: This is Doctor Phlox.

title: Fallen Hero
line: The Vulcan?

title: Fallen Hero
line: She's undergoing dermal regeneration.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Open it.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I will not. I don't know what business you have with this woman, but when she was brought in here she became my patient. If I remove her from the imaging chamber prematurely, she'll die.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Open it. Yes?

title: Fallen Hero
line: Our sensors just went down, Captain.

title: Fallen Hero
line: What's causing it?

title: Fallen Hero
line: Enterprise is redirecting our jamming signal.

title: Fallen Hero
line: No! (Archer pulls him out of the line of fire as they shoot at the imaging chamber. The display above switches to 'System Failure diag ID 1010'. Enterprise shakes slightly.)

title: Fallen Hero
line: Report. Answer me, what's going on?

title: Fallen Hero
line: I imagine they have their hands full right about now.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I believe that's the Sh'Raan. She's a Vulcan combat cruiser. One of their most powerful, if I'm not mistaken.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Sir, the Captain of the Sh'Raan wants to speak to you.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Put it up.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Captain Archer, are you in any danger?

title: Fallen Hero
line: You could say that.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Tell the Mazarites to turn their weapons over immediately or we'll destroy their ships. We'll be standing by, Captain.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Thank you.

title: Fallen Hero
line: We did what we came to do. That's all that matters.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I am sorry to disappoint you. I look forward to adding this incident to my testimony at your trial. Captain's starlog, February 9, 2152. The Vulcans have allowed the Mazarites to leave. Ambassador V'Lar says there's a good reason for doing so, though she's certainly not sharing it with me.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Someday I'd like to walk into a room without it seeming like a state visit.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Occupational hazard?

title: Fallen Hero
line: I'll be along in a moment.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Thank you, Captain. I'm sorry for the trouble I've caused you and your crew.

title: Fallen Hero
line: We're glad we could help.

title: Fallen Hero
line: I sense a great bond between you. A bond of trust and respect, but also a bond of friendship. I think it bodes well for the future relations of our two peoples.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Goodbye, Ambassador.

title: Fallen Hero
line: Live long, and prosper.

title: Desert Crossing
line: I've got my eye on a place called Suraya Bay. Villas built right into the cliffs. A perfect spot to enjoy a few good books. Might even do a little diving when I Computer, pause. Archer.

title: Desert Crossing
line: We're picking up a distress call, Captain. It's coming from a vessel approximately two light years to port.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Any idea who it is?

title: Desert Crossing
line: No, sir. Should we alter course?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Go ahead. I'll be right there. Looks like your walk on the beach will have to wait.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Plasma residue?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Your warp injectors were full of it.

title: Desert Crossing
line: I must be more diligent about routine maintenance.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Unless you enjoy being adrift in the middle of nowhere.

title: Desert Crossing
line: I'm sorry to inconvenience you something this trivial. Be sure to thank Mister Tucker for his time.

title: Desert Crossing
line: He wanted me to thank you. It isn't every day he gets to tinker with alien engines. We also found a microfracture on your starboard hull. They're sealing it now.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Oh, your crew is very thorough.

title: Desert Crossing
line: We were glad to help.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Do you answer every distress call you pick up?

title: Desert Crossing
line: If we can.

title: Desert Crossing
line: The galaxy could use more people like you.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Tomorrow you'll join me in my home. Bring Commander Tucker. I'll prepare a meal in your honor. It's the least I can do to show my gratitude.

title: Desert Crossing
line: That's very generous, but I promised my crew a trip to Risa.

title: Desert Crossing
line: That can wait one more day, can't it?

title: Desert Crossing
line: If I put them off much longer, I'm going to have a mutiny on my hands.

title: Desert Crossing
line: There's going to be a Geskana match. I doubt you've ever seen anything like it.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Geskana?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Yes. You might want to participate, assuming you enjoy competition. I should warn you, Captain, I am easily offended.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Send me the coordinates. I'll break the news to my crew.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Dress for warm weather.

title: Desert Crossing
line: If it's all the same to you, Captain I'll sit this one out.

title: Desert Crossing
line: It's not like you to pass up an away mission.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Well, I'm up to my ears in work. The impulse manifolds need to be purged, the gravity plating on C deck still isn't aligned.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Trip.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Desert, sir? The heat, the dry air. You know how it sucks the life out of me.

title: Desert Crossing
line: What about the two weeks we spent in Australia? We had a great time.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Survival training in the outback? Drinking recycled sweat and eating snake meat? That's your idea of a great time?

title: Desert Crossing
line: It's not going to be like that. I get the feeling Zobral's a man who likes to indulge his guests. He's promised to roll out the red carpet for us. It'll be more fun than purging impulse manifolds. Well, suit yourself. I'll see if Malcolm's interested. But I was hoping you'd enjoy spending some time with your captain.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Promise I won't have to eat any snake meat?

title: Desert Crossing
line: It's hotter than hell out there. Forty one degrees.

title: Desert Crossing
line: It's a dry heat.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Welcome.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Good to be here. You remember Commander Tucker.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Yes, of course, of course. This is the man who repaired my ship. A brilliant engineer.

title: Desert Crossing
line: It was just a couple of clogged injectors.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Oh, you are far too modest. Well, I hope you're hungry. I've prepared quite a feast.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Are there many deserts on your world?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Quite a few, but none as big as this one.

title: Desert Crossing
line: From orbit, you'd think the entire planet's nothing but sand.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Oh well, we have a handful of lakes and small seas. What about Earth?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Two thirds water.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Extraordinary. More wine?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Please.

title: Desert Crossing
line: What's that called again?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Yalasat. It's made from a cactus that grows in the northern foothills. How was your roast teracaq?

title: Desert Crossing
line: It's very good. When Trip and I did our survival training, in the desert, we never ate this well.

title: Desert Crossing
line: I must have lost about three kilos during that last week. The heat always takes away my appetite.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Doesn't seem to be bothering you now.

title: Desert Crossing
line: I guess I'm getting acclimated.

title: Desert Crossing
line: It must be difficult adjusting to new cultures.

title: Desert Crossing
line: It's challenging at times, but that's why we're out here.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Did you ever think of turning back?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Only once. We were attacked by a hostile species with a lot more firepower than Enterprise. I set a course back to Earth to upgrade our weapons, but we ended up having to do the repairs ourselves.

title: Desert Crossing
line: They haven't bothered us since.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Sounds like you've had an eventful journey.

title: Desert Crossing
line: It's had its share of surprises.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Well, perhaps your visit here will be one of them. Oh, you're going to enjoy this.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Looks delicious. What is it?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Blood soup. I don't usually eat this well but I promised your Captain an exceptional meal.

title: Desert Crossing
line: What are these little chunks?

title: Desert Crossing
line: The essence of the male, chopped, and seasoned.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Beautiful tapestries.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Thank you. Which do you prefer?

title: Desert Crossing
line: That one's interesting.

title: Desert Crossing
line: It's yours.

title: Desert Crossing
line: No, no, no. I couldn't.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Please. Consider it a gift.

title: Desert Crossing
line: You're far too generous. Besides, I wouldn't have any place to hang it.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Something smaller then.

title: Desert Crossing
line: I know you will appreciate this. A Suliban made it. A Suliban I met several years ago. Interesting people, don't you agree?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Thank you.

title: Desert Crossing
line: The Geskana match is about to begin. I'm hoping you will honor us by participating.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Now? I just ate half a teracaq.

title: Desert Crossing
line: You will be glad you did. Geskana requires a great deal of strength.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Think you're ready?

title: Desert Crossing
line: I'll give it a shot, Captain.

title: Desert Crossing
line: I can't promise we'll win any trophies.

title: Desert Crossing
line: This is an ideal game for men like you.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Thanks.

title: Desert Crossing
line: We're being hailed.

title: Desert Crossing
line: The Captain?

title: Desert Crossing
line: No. It's coming from a city on the far side of the desert.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Put it through. This is Enterprise.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Several hours ago, you launched a small vessel to an encampment in the Cygniai Expanse. Would you tell me why?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Our Captain and Chief Engineer were invited.

title: Desert Crossing
line: By whom?

title: Desert Crossing
line: A man named Zobral. And you are?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Chancellor Trellit. Why are you in contact with this man?

title: Desert Crossing
line: His ship was damaged and we assisted him. In return, he offered his hospitality.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Hospitality? I hope you're aware that most likely you'll never see your Captain or Engineer again.

title: Desert Crossing
line: You all right?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Never better.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Open, open up. Block out. Here, here. Here, here. Get in front of him. Cut him off. Now.

title: Desert Crossing
line: So close.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Two centimeters to the right and you'd have had it.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Next time I'll set you up with a no-look pass.

title: Desert Crossing
line: All right.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Archer.

title: Desert Crossing
line: I need to speak to you, Captain.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Can it wait? We're a little busy at the moment.

title: Desert Crossing
line: It's urgent. Are you alone?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Hold on a minute. It's my Science Officer. She says it's important. Do you mind?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Take your time.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Catch your breath.

title: Desert Crossing
line: What's the problem?

title: Desert Crossing
line: I've been contacted by a government official in a city about two hundred kilometers from where you are now. He claims that you're in danger.

title: Desert Crossing
line: What kind of danger?

title: Desert Crossing
line: According to him

title: Desert Crossing
line: Zobral and his men are terrorists.

title: Desert Crossing
line: They've been responsible for numerous attacks on civilian targets within the city.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Maybe I'm wrong, but they don't seem like terrorists to me.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Perhaps not, but until we're certain who they are, I suggest you return to the ship.

title: Desert Crossing
line: We're on our way.

title: Desert Crossing
line: I hope everything is all right.

title: Desert Crossing
line: The problem with being a starship captain is you're never really off duty. I'm afraid we have to cut our visit short.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.

title: Desert Crossing
line: hat's going on?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Problem with the starboard engine. T'Pol says she needs us up there right away.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Can't we at least finish this quarter?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Remember those impulse manifolds you said needed purging? You were right.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Well, thanks for one hell of a game.

title: Desert Crossing
line: You must have other people that can correct this problem.

title: Desert Crossing
line: I wish we did.

title: Desert Crossing
line: As I said, Captain, I am easily offended.

title: Desert Crossing
line: We'll come back if there's time, I promise.

title: Desert Crossing
line: You should not believe the Torothans. I have just been informed that we picked up a lengthy transmission between your vessel and Chancellor Trellit. Whatever he told your Science Officer it is not true. I wanted this to wait till later, but I beg you, let me explain the real reason why I asked you here. You have a reputation for being fair, a man of great integrity. When you hear what I have to say, I am certain you will want to help us.

title: Desert Crossing
line: It is called a yrott. The word means to stand apart. When we lived in the cities we were forced to wear these whenever we walked in public.

title: Desert Crossing
line: I take it those days are over.

title: Desert Crossing
line: When the caste system was finally abolished, we were led to believe that everyone would be treated equally. I remember the celebrations. Yrotts being burned in the streets. People saying that we had finally been granted our rights. The Torothan Clan signed the accord, but they never abided by it. They still control the government, the lands, the resources, everything. We spent ten years staging protests, appealing to the courts, until finally we realized there was only one way to get their attention. We have hundreds of camps just like this one all across the desert, and we are going to keep attacking the Torothans until our voices are heard. They call us terrorists, but the truth is they have been terrorizing us for centuries.

title: Desert Crossing
line: You said you brought me down here for a reason. I have a feeling it wasn't to hear a history lesson.

title: Desert Crossing
line: The Torothans have ten times as many soldiers as we do. We won't last much longer without your help.

title: Desert Crossing
line: I really don't see what I can do for you.

title: Desert Crossing
line: They said you would be humble. I scanned your vessel. You have an arsenal of powerful weapons, but more importantly, I need your wisdom. Our current strategy isn't working, but I am confident that together we can find one that does. I would be honored to fight alongside you, as would all of my men.

title: Desert Crossing
line: What the hell was that?

title: Desert Crossing
line: Torothan cruisers. Usually they begin their bombardment after dark. They're getting started early today.

title: Desert Crossing
line: I don't know what you've heard about me, but I think you've been misled.

title: Desert Crossing
line: What about the Suliban?

title: Desert Crossing
line: What about them?

title: Desert Crossing
line: You liberated a detention camp, freed thousands of prisoners.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Who told you that?

title: Desert Crossing
line: A Suliban transport captain. He told me of an explorer who was also a great warrior. A man who helped them defeat an entire army. Captain Jonathan Archer.

title: Desert Crossing
line: Two cruisers, sir. They've hit one of our pulse cannons.

title: Desert Crossing

title: Marauders

line: Our ship took some damage a few weeks ago. We lost most of our reserves.

line: I'm sorry, but we can't help you. Two of our pumps are offline. You'll have to return later in the season.

title: Marauders
line: There's nothing we can do.

line: Are you certain? You seem to have a large inventory. Our sensors showed over eighty thousand liters.
