line: Come in.

title: The Seventh
line: Good morning.

title: The Seventh
line: Captain.

title: The Seventh
line: Toast?

title: The Seventh
line: No, thank you.

title: The Seventh
line: What can I do for you?

title: The Seventh
line: Admiral Forrest will be calling you this afternoon, sir.

title: The Seventh
line: Oh, will he? And how would you know that?

title: The Seventh
line: I was contacted by the Vulcan High Command last night. They've requested my services regarding a matter of security.

title: The Seventh
line: And they've already asked Admiral Forrest?

title: The Seventh
line: He should be contacting you this afternoon.

title: The Seventh
line: Matter of security?

title: The Seventh
line: The Admiral will inform you that Enterprise will be asked to alter course to the Pernaia system, where I will need a shuttlepod and a pilot for three to five days.

title: The Seventh
line: You didn't answer my question. What kind of matter of security?

title: The Seventh
line: A Vulcan ship will rendezvous with the shuttlepod when my mission is completed.

title: The Seventh
line: They're sending you to get somebody. Somebody you'll be handing over to the Vulcans. Why you?

title: The Seventh
line: Admiral Forrest will be contacting you this afternoon.

title: The Seventh
line: Thanks for being so enlightening. Dismissed. Captain's Log, supplemental. As anticipated, I was contacted by Admiral Forrest who has ordered us to accommodate the Vulcans' request.

title: The Seventh
line: Did you find the co-ordinates?

title: The Seventh
line: Pernaia Prime. Yes, sir.

title: The Seventh
line: Set a course. When we arrive, you'll be piloting the shuttlepod.

title: The Seventh
line: Where exactly will we be going?

title: The Seventh
line: Somewhere in the Pernaia System, no doubt. As far as the exact location, Admiral Forrest doesn't even know that. It seems the Sub-Commander's on a highly classified mission.

title: The Seventh
line: Is this Pernaia Prime inhabited?

title: The Seventh
line: The Vulcan database says it has a methane-based atmosphere.

title: The Seventh
line: So, she's going to another planet in the system. Are we supposed to play some kind of guessing game?

title: The Seventh
line: No, we're supposed to wait at Pernaia Prime for T'Pol and Travis to finish their mission.

title: The Seventh
line: And do what in the meantime?

title: The Seventh
line: I could use a few days to recalibrate the torpedo launchers.

title: The Seventh
line: I could polish all the handles and rails in Engineering.

title: The Seventh
line: I guess I could purge the impulse reactors.

title: The Seventh
line: It's only for a few days. We've got plenty to keep ourselves busy. Is there anything specific you and Travis are going to need?

title: The Seventh
line: Cold-weather gear, restraints and phase pistols.

title: The Seventh
line: Come in.

title: The Seventh
line: If the Vulcan High Command doesn't approve of the water polo match I'm watching, I'd be happy to find another.

title: The Seventh
line: Your orders to bring me to Pernaia came from Starfleet, not the High Command.

title: The Seventh
line: What can I do for you?

title: The Seventh
line: I have a personal matter I'd like to diskuss.

title: The Seventh
line: Before I joined the Science Directorate I was assigned to the Ministry of Security. I was trained in reconnaissance and retrieval.

title: The Seventh
line: Move over, Porthos. Let the lady sit down. Sounds like this is going to be good. Come on, sit down.

title: The Seventh
line: How long ago are we talking about?

title: The Seventh
line: I completed my training seventeen years ago.

title: The Seventh
line: Go ahead.

title: The Seventh
line: Are you familiar with a planet called Agaron?

title: The Seventh
line: They're close allies with the Vulcans, right?

title: The Seventh
line: Not always. Agaron was a very corrupt world. When their leaders were first trying to forge an alliance with Vulcan they asked for our assistance. That was nearly thirty years ago. Hundreds of our agents were surgically altered and sent to infiltrate the most criminal factions of Agaron society. Eventually, they were instrumental in the overthrow of those factions.

title: The Seventh
line: You're not going to tell me you're one of those agents.

title: The Seventh
line: I'm not that old, Captain. After the alliance was formalized, the Vulcan agents were recalled. They all returned voluntarily, all but nineteen.

title: The Seventh
line: I guess even Vulcans can fall prey to temptation.

title: The Seventh
line: The Ministry of Security sent a team of newly-trained operatives to retrieve them. I was only able to apprehend five of the six fugitives assigned to me.

title: The Seventh
line: So tomorrow you get to pick up number six. Why couldn't someone else do it? Why you?

title: The Seventh
line: The Ministry considers it a matter of honor.

title: The Seventh
line: How very Vulcan. So, why have you decided to tell me all this?

title: The Seventh
line: I'd like you to come with me.

title: The Seventh
line: What?

title: The Seventh
line: The man I'm being sent to apprehend is extremely dangerous. It would be wise for me to have assistance.

title: The Seventh
line: You said there's a Vulcan ship coming. I'm sure they can provide all the assistance you'll need.

title: The Seventh
line: I'd prefer it if you'd come with me, Captain.

title: The Seventh
line: Why?

title: The Seventh
line: I need to be with someone I can trust. If you don't wish to help me, I understand. Good night.

title: The Seventh
line: What's his name? The man we're going to apprehend.

title: The Seventh
line: Menos.

title: The Seventh
line: See you in the morning.

title: The Seventh
line: If you agreed to go with her you must know something about what she's up to.

title: The Seventh
line: We'll be back in three to five days, Trip. If that Vulcan ship comes snooping around, the last thing you want to tell them is that I'm with T'Pol.

title: The Seventh
line: Why's that? Why would you being with her be a problem to them?

title: The Seventh
line: Three to five days, Trip.

title: The Seventh
line: Come on, Captain. Last night, you were just as frustrated as I was about having to sit on your hands while she goes off and does whatever it is she's going off to do.

title: The Seventh
line: This isn't just a case of curiosity. What if you get hurt, kidnapped? You put me in charge of this ship and you won't tell me where you're going? How am I supposed to be a good temporary Captain if I don't know where my people are? Tell me that.

title: The Seventh
line: She's got some unfinished business, Trip. I'm not sure why, but she needs me to go along. We'll be okay.

title: The Seventh
line: There are a lot of definitions of unfinished business. Could you be a little more specific?

title: The Seventh
line: You're in charge, Commander. Have you given Travis the coordinates?

title: The Seventh
line: Yes.

title: The Seventh
line: Have fun.

title: The Seventh
line: Before he was sent to Agaron, the dorsal lobes of his ears were surgically altered. The ridge on his forehead was added sometime afterward.

title: The Seventh
line: Why didn't he want to come home?

title: The Seventh
line: He was assigned to infiltrate a cell of smugglers. He learned their craft. He became very proficient at it, amassed a large fortune.

title: The Seventh
line: Smuggling what?

title: The Seventh
line: Synthetic biotoxins used to manufacture transgenic weapons. I spent three months trying to find him. He used his wealth wisely. Whenever I'd get close, I'd find he'd left a day or two before.

title: The Seventh
line: You never found him?

title: The Seventh
line: Only once, on Risa. They thought they were invulnerable.

title: The Seventh
line: They?

title: The Seventh
line: He. He thought he was invulnerable there, that no one would think to look for him on such a peaceful place.

title: The Seventh
line: What happened?

title: The Seventh
line: I got very close. Twenty meters, maybe ten.

title: The Seventh
line: T'Pol?

title: The Seventh
line: I never found him again. No one did. Not until now.

title: The Seventh
line: He's here.

title: The Seventh
line: Where?

title: The Seventh
line: Within thirty meters.

title: The Seventh
line: If he sees T'Pol, he may try to get to his ship.

title: The Seventh
line: He saw me.

title: The Seventh
line: Which way?

title: The Seventh
line: I'm not certain.

title: The Seventh
line: I couldn't agree more.

title: The Seventh
line: Don't move.

title: The Seventh
line: You have no jurisdiction here.

title: The Seventh
line: Follow me.

title: The Seventh
line: Come in. Gentlemen, come in. Glad you could join me.

title: The Seventh
line: Water polo?

title: The Seventh
line: Very exciting sport. You should learn more about it.

title: The Seventh
line: Please, sit down. I had Chef prepare a special lunch. Bangers and mash for you, and, Denobulan sausage for the Doctor.

title: The Seventh
line: Very nice.

title: The Seventh
line: Are you sure the Captain wouldn't have a problem with you using his dining room?

title: The Seventh
line: Acting Captain, Captain's Mess. I don't see a problem. Thank you, Crewman.

title: The Seventh
line: Enjoy.

title: The Seventh
line: Thank you. Oh, I detected a lymphatic virus on board this morning. Most likely it sneaked in with one of the deuterium canisters. We should probably inoculate the crew.

title: The Seventh
line: Why didn't the bio-scanners detect it?

title: The Seventh
line: Well, it's a very reliable device, but it's not perfect. The inoculation does have some side effects.

title: The Seventh
line: What kind of side effects?

title: The Seventh
line: Headache, nausea, diarrhea. But they would subside in a day or two. Do I have your permission?

title: The Seventh
line: I'd hate to be responsible for giving the crew the runs. Maybe you should wait till the Captain gets back.

title: The Seventh
line: I'm afraid the virus will have spread by then. I really need an answer today.

title: The Seventh
line: Why don't I get back to you later, Doc?

title: The Seventh
line: Not too much later.

title: The Seventh
line: While we're on the subject of approvals, I promised Captain Archer that I'd recalibrate the torpedo launchers. I'll need to divert computer access from Main Engineering.

title: The Seventh
line: That would mean we'd have to power down the warp core.

title: The Seventh
line: It'll only be for a day. We're not exactly going anywhere.

title: The Seventh
line: We're also not at war. I'm just not comfortable taking the engines offline right now.

title: The Seventh
line: Is that the Chief Engineer talking, or the Acting Captain?

title: The Seventh
line: Let me get back to you. Tucker.

title: The Seventh
line: We were just hailed by the Vulcan ship Nyran, sir. It's approaching the system at high warp. They're asking to speak with Captain Archer.

title: The Seventh
line: Tell them the Captain's indisposed at the moment. He'll get back to them in a little while.

title: The Seventh
line: Yes, sir.

title: The Seventh
line: The Captain said not to tell the Vulcans he went with T'Pol. He was very emphatic about that.

title: The Seventh
line: It's going to be difficult to convince them he's indisposed for the next four days.

title: The Seventh
line: Go ahead.

title: The Seventh
line: Captain Tavek says he has a message from Admiral Forrest. He seems very anxious to speak with Captain Archer. What shall I tell him?

title: The Seventh
line: I'll get back to you.

title: The Seventh
line: Your warrant is valid, but you won't be able to take him. Not for at least four hours. We've begun thermalising the landing deck.

title: The Seventh
line: We just need to get him to our ship.

title: The Seventh
line: There's a half centimeter of xylathoric acid on that deck. I wouldn't recommend it. Not if you value those pretty feet of yours.

title: The Seventh
line: Do you have somewhere we can put him until we leave?

title: The Seventh
line: Does this look like a prison to you?

title: The Seventh
line: Any one of these people could be working with him.

title: The Seventh
line: The Ministry of Security very clear about that. He works alone.

title: The Seventh
line: I haven't always.

title: The Seventh
line: You're human. And you as well. They wanted to rehabilitate me, bring me home, flatten my forehead and re-point my ears. They wanted to teach me to forget the life they had taught me so carefully how to live. They assumed I had become corrupt. and that left to my own devices I would remain corrupt. Three years in a Vulcan clinic. Rehabilitation. Can you blame me for running? I'm not a thief. I'm not a smuggler. I never was. I worked with smugglers. I worked very close with them for a long time. It's what I had been trained to do. Do you know how I've survived the last twenty years? How I've fed my family? I haul spent warp injector casings. Not a very popular occupation, but a necessary one. A doctor on Andoria says that my hemolytic cell count is over three thousand. You don't find too many old men hauling spent injector casings. In my left front pocket, if you don't mind.

title: The Seventh
line: I wouldn't. It may be a weapon.

title: The Seventh
line: It's a hologram of my family. They won't hurt you.

title: The Seventh
line: The injector casings are going to take me away from them soon enough. I don't want to die in a Vulcan prison.

title: The Seventh
line: The information that I was given says that you buy high grade biotoxins and sell them to anyone who will meet your price.

title: The Seventh
line: If all of the Ministry's reports about me were true I could easily shape-shift and slip out of these restraints, or sprout wings and fly to my ship.

title: The Seventh
line: Why should she believe a fugitive and not her own government?

title: The Seventh
line: Because her government sent one hundred nine agents to Agaron thirty years ago, and they want all one hundred nine accounted for, Right or wrong, dead or alive.

title: The Seventh
line: If you're innocent, I'm sure you'll be given a chance to defend yourself.

title: The Seventh
line: Bur I'm guilty. I'm guilty of not returning when I was told to. I'm innocent of selling biotoxins but I'm guilty of being a fugitive. But I don't deserve to go to prison, and I don't deserve to be shot.

title: The Seventh
line: We're here to take you to Vulcan. No one's going to shoot you.

title: The Seventh
line: What about her?

title: The Seventh
line: You're a liar.

title: The Seventh
line: T'Pol!

title: The Seventh
line: What are you doing? T'Pol?

title: The Seventh
line: He's not telling the truth.

title: The Seventh
line: Where the hell are you going? T'Pol!

title: The Seventh
line: He says he has a ship full of injector casings.

title: The Seventh
line: But the platform's covered with acid!

title: The Seventh
line: Jossen!

title: The Seventh
line: You're sure?

title: The Seventh
line: There's no record of them ever having spoken, but I can't be certain.

title: The Seventh
line: Has he ever been to Earth?

title: The Seventh
line: If he has, the Vulcan database doesn't mention it.

title: The Seventh
line: I hope they haven't put Starfleet yearbook photos into that database. Let's get this over with. Captain Tavek, is there something I can do for you?

title: The Seventh
line: Captain Archer?

title: The Seventh
line: Yes. Is there a problem?

title: The Seventh
line: You seem very young for a Starfleet Captain.

title: The Seventh
line: Healthy living. You have a message from Admiral Forrest?

title: The Seventh
line: I'm not certain what this means, but the Admiral asked me to inform you that Cal beat Stanford, seven to three.

title: The Seventh
line: I'll be sure to tell him.

title: The Seventh
line: Tell who?

title: The Seventh
line: I'm afraid it's confidential. Thank you for relaying the message. Archer out.

title: The Seventh
line: That wasn't too smart. You could have been hurt. What did you find?

title: The Seventh
line: Spent injector casings.

title: The Seventh
line: You'll have to go through decon when we get back.

title: The Seventh
line: I want to speak to Menos alone. Would you allow me to do that?

title: The Seventh
line: Come on, Travis. Let's see if we can find something to eat.

title: The Seventh
line: Who is Jossen?

title: The Seventh
line: You didn't find what you were looking for, did you?

title: The Seventh
line: Who is Jossen?

title: The Seventh
line: If this is your idea of humor.

title: The Seventh
line: Tell me who he is.

title: The Seventh
line: Jossen was no different than me. He didn't want to be rehabilitated, either.

title: The Seventh
line: Where did I meet him?

title: The Seventh
line: Meet him? On Risa. Jossen and I were on Risa in the Tropical Zone. We were innocent of the crimes the Ministry had accused us of but we were running, all the same. Why do you want me to tell you things you already know?

title: The Seventh
line: You're telling me lies.

title: The Seventh
line: No. The truth.

title: The Seventh
line: I followed you to Risa, no one else. I bribed the Tellarite transport captain who brought you there. He told me exactly where to find you. I wasn't looking for anyone else.

title: The Seventh
line: Then why are you asking me about Jossen? He never hurt anyone. He didn't deserve to be hunted down like an animal.

title: The Seventh
line: I killed him.

title: The Seventh
line: Yes, and he didn't deserve to be killed. He was an innocent man, just like I am.

title: The Seventh
line: You really don't remember. How is that possible? Why did you kill him? He never would have hurt you.

title: The Seventh
line: Stop talking.

title: The Seventh
line: You're a Vulcan. You're trained to repress the emotion of killing, not the memory of the act.

title: The Seventh
line: I said, stop talking!

title: The Seventh
line: Look what it's done to you, taking an innocent life. Bringing me back to Vulcan will be no different. You'll be destroying another life. How will that affect you? Will you conveniently forget what you're about to do to me?

title: The Seventh
line: Where's Menos?

title: The Seventh
line: Get back over there.

title: The Seventh
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Seventh
line: What happened?

title: The Seventh
line: There were seven.

title: The Seventh
line: Seven what?

title: The Seventh
line: I was sent to bring back seven fugitives, not six.

title: The Seventh
line: I don't understand.

title: The Seventh
line: Menos had a partner, or a friend. I'm not sure. His name was Jossen. I followed them both to Risa, not just Menos. The day I told you I saw Menos and lost him, I saw Jossen as well. They tried to escape. Jossen fell to the ground. He began to reach for his weapon.

title: The Seventh
line: But you fired first?

title: The Seventh
line: I had forgotten all of it, until today.

title: The Seventh
line: How?

title: The Seventh
line: Have you heard of the Fullara?

title: The Seventh
line: No.

title: The Seventh
line: It's an obsolete Vulcan ritual where the memory of an event is repressed along with the emotions associated with it.

title: The Seventh
line: And you had this.

title: The Seventh
line: Fullara.

title: The Seventh
line: This Fullara ritual performed?

title: The Seventh
line: When I returned to Vulcan, I was unsettled. I resigned my position with the Ministry and sought guidance at the Sanctuary of P'Jem. For months, one of the Elders worked with me to control the guilt, to restrain the despair of having taken a life, but the feelings remained.

title: The Seventh
line: Why would you feel guilty if this Jossen was about to fire at you?

title: The Seventh
line: I suppose I was never certain what his intentions were. The Elder had no choice but to perform the ritual. When I left the Sanctuary I didn't remember anything about Jossen or the Fullara.

title: The Seventh
line: When did it start coming back?

title: The Seventh
line: When the first call came in about this new mission. Maybe that's why I wanted you with me. What if Jossen wasn't a smuggler? What if he was innocent? Then it wouldn't have mattered whether he intended to use that weapon or not.

title: The Seventh
line: That doesn't make any sense. What's Menos been telling you?

title: The Seventh
line: Menos's ship was filled with injector casings, nothing else. He has a family. Our scans should be able to confirm if he's dying of radiation poisoning.

title: The Seventh
line: What's he been telling you?

title: The Seventh
line: He kicked over the table!

title: The Seventh
line: And you claim you're a peaceful man.

title: The Seventh
line: Ironic, isn't it? Burning to death on a frozen moon? But I'd rather die here than be brought back and punished for crimes I never committed.

title: The Seventh
line: T'Pol!

title: The Seventh
line: Refasten them.

title: The Seventh
line: Where's Menos?

title: The Seventh
line: Travis! Come on.

title: The Seventh
line: Where's his ship? Your mission is to return him to Vulcan, not determine whether he's guilty or innocent. Where's his ship?

title: The Seventh
line: He's not aboard.

title: The Seventh
line: Let's be sure.

title: The Seventh
line: We'll all need to go through decon now.

title: The Seventh
line: He's not here.

title: The Seventh
line: Was that the only way in? Go back to the cockpit, Travis.

title: The Seventh
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Seventh
line: Get life support fired up if you can. It's pretty cold.

title: The Seventh
line: He should've gotten here before us. This ship shouldn't be here.

title: The Seventh
line: Why risk using his own vessel? He'd know we'd follow him.

title: The Seventh
line: So he could've left with any one of those other ships.

title: The Seventh
line: Any one of them.

title: The Seventh
line: You seem okay with that.

title: The Seventh
line: When we return to Enterprise I'll inform the Vulcan ship that Menos escaped. If the High Command wishes, they can question as many of the vessels that left here as they can find.

title: The Seventh
line: You're giving up a lot easier than I would've guessed.

title: The Seventh
line: He's obviously gone.

title: The Seventh
line: We don't know that. He got to you, didn't he? You're beginning to doubt yourself. He figured if he could get you to question what you did seventeen years ago, you'd begin to question what you're doing right now.

title: The Seventh
line: I may have killed an innocent man seventeen years ago.

title: The Seventh
line: Did Jossen reach for his weapon or not?

title: The Seventh
line: I don't know.

title: The Seventh
line: Is that what you remember, or what Menos wants you to remember?

title: The Seventh
line: What's the difference?

title: The Seventh
line: There's a big difference. He's playing on your guilt. Don't you see that?

title: The Seventh
line: That's impossible. I went to P'Jem. They performed the ritual.

title: The Seventh
line: Don't give me that! Your emotional immune system started to collapse again the minute you remembered what happened that day on Risa.

title: The Seventh
line: Captain.

title: The Seventh
line: What is it, Travis?

title: The Seventh
line: There's something funny up here, sir. Think you could take a look?

title: The Seventh
line: What's up?

title: The Seventh
line: After I got the board running, I brought life support up to level three. As soon as I got more light in here, I noticed some condensation on this sub-panel.

title: The Seventh
line: There's a hell of a lot of energy flowing through those circuits. Any idea what they are?

title: The Seventh
line: Our scanner showed everything powered down.

title: The Seventh
line: Well, obviously something's powered up. There's one way to find out what it is.

title: The Seventh
line: I'm a very patient man, T'Pol.

title: The Seventh
line: I was simply waiting for you to leave, but your Captain's curiosity has put an end to that. Would you please lower your weapon?

title: The Seventh
line: There's some kind of energy field running.

title: The Seventh
line: I don't want to harm T'Pol, Captain, but I will.

title: The Seventh
line: Those are violent words for a peaceful man.

title: The Seventh
line: At the moment, I'm a man who needs to survive. There's a locker right next to you. I want you to both put your weapons down and then walk into it. You won't be hurt.

title: The Seventh
line: What about her?

title: The Seventh
line: T'Pol is my guarantee that the two of you will walk quickly and quietly into the locker. Please.

title: The Seventh
line: The locking code is one six six one. There's a very specific tone when it's entered properly.

title: The Seventh
line: You okay?

title: The Seventh
line: Yes.

title: The Seventh
line: We don't do quickly and quietly very well but we are good at arithmetic. It seems there are three of us and only one of you.

title: The Seventh
line: Stop! Please!

title: The Seventh
line: I don't trust this guy, Travis. Find something to tie him up with.

title: The Seventh
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Seventh
line: What are you doing?

title: The Seventh
line: Get up!

title: The Seventh
line: Stop!

title: The Seventh
line: You're not going to shoot me, T'Pol. You're not going to kill another innocent man. This is none of your concern, Captain. You know nothing about what happened on Risa.

title: The Seventh
line: Captain?

title: The Seventh
line: Why did you want me here?

title: The Seventh
line: Because I trust you.

title: The Seventh
line: Then trust me. You were sent to apprehend him, not to judge him.

title: The Seventh
line: He's not going to get out of that too quickly.

title: The Seventh
line: I think I know why he was so nervous about us firing at him while he was over here. Look at this.

title: The Seventh
line: Biotoxins. If one of our weapons had struck this.

title: The Seventh
line: I guess he was hauling more than injector casings after all.

title: The Seventh
line: I guess he was. Captain's Starlog, supplemental. The Vulcan ship Nyran was waiting at the prearranged coordinates. After transferring Menos to their custody, we've returned to Enterprise.

title: The Seventh
line: What's your status, Trip?

title: The Seventh
line: Everything's ready to go, Captain. Welcome back.

title: The Seventh
line: Thanks. We'll be going to warp three.

title: The Seventh
line: You got it.

title: The Seventh
line: Now that your secret mission is over you think you can give your Chief Engineer a little hint about what you were up to?

title: The Seventh
line: Did I say warp three? I meant warp four, Commander.

title: The Seventh
line: Not even a hint? Warp four. Aye, Captain.

title: The Seventh
line: Come in.

title: The Seventh
line: Sub-Commander. Am I about to get another call from Admiral Forrest?

title: The Seventh
line: No, sir.

title: The Seventh
line: Sorry. Dealing with these memories it's not going to be easy for you, is it?

title: The Seventh
line: No, it's not.

title: The Seventh
line: If you feel you need a leave of absence.

title: The Seventh
line: That won't be necessary. I was much younger then.

title: The Seventh
line: You've also spent a lot of time around humans lately.

title: The Seventh
line: You do have a way of putting questionable actions behind you.

title: The Seventh
line: When you don't have the ability to repress emotions, you learn to deal with them and move on. Was there something else?

title: The Seventh
line: If you ever need someone you can trust.

title: The Seventh
line: I won't forget.

title: The Communicator
line: I need to spend more time in the gym.

title: The Communicator
line: If I knew there were going to be so many hills I would have picked a different city to explore.

title: The Communicator
line: It was worth every step, sir. The architecture alone.

title: The Communicator
line: I could have spent all day in that temple.

title: The Communicator
line: With your permission, Captain, I'd like to write the report to Starfleet. It was my first visit to a pre-warp culture. Seems only fitting.

title: The Communicator
line: I don't suppose it has anything to do with the tactical situation down there.

title: The Communicator
line: Am I that obvious?

title: The Communicator
line: I can't think of a better man for the job.

title: The Communicator
line: Welcome home.

title: The Communicator
line: Any unexpected guests?

title: The Communicator
line: Not a single parasite, spore or virus. I take it your expedition was productive?

title: The Communicator
line: Very.

title: The Communicator
line: You're done here.

title: The Communicator
line: You know, as interesting as that was, it's always good to get home.

title: The Communicator
line: The speaker at the political rally, what was his name? Chancellor Kultrey?

title: The Communicator
line: Kultarey.

title: The Communicator
line: You could write a book about him alone. His speech reminded me of Winston Churchill before the Second World War.

title: The Communicator
line: Something wrong? Malcolm?

title: The Communicator
line: My communicator.

title: The Communicator
line: What about it?

title: The Communicator
line: It's gone.

title: The Communicator
line: It's not in decon. Any luck?

title: The Communicator
line: None yet.

title: The Communicator
line: What about the launch bay crew? Could they have found it while they were securing the pod?

title: The Communicator
line: I've already spoken to them.

title: The Communicator
line: I did everything but tear up the floor plating.

title: The Communicator
line: When was the last time you remember having it?

title: The Communicator
line: I contacted T'Pol to let her know we'd entered the city.

title: The Communicator
line: After that. Did you have any reason to take it out of your pocket?

title: The Communicator
line: No.

title: The Communicator
line: Are you sure?

title: The Communicator
line: I'd remember. Either I dropped it or someone picked my pocket.

title: The Communicator
line: We covered a lot of ground. It could be anywhere.

title: The Communicator
line: I think I can narrow down the search, Captain. An inverse carrier wave should amplify its power signature. With any luck, I'll be able to isolate it.

title: The Communicator
line: I'm getting something. I've got it down to two square kilometers.

title: The Communicator
line: Can you do a little better?

title: The Communicator
line: I'll try.

title: The Communicator
line: Didn't you say something about a war brewing down there?

title: The Communicator
line: We saw a lot of propaganda, but from what we could tell nobody started fighting yet.

title: The Communicator
line: It's crucial we retrieve the technology. We can't risk contaminating a pre-warp culture.

title: The Communicator
line: I've isolated the signal to within three city blocks. That's the best I can do, sir.

title: The Communicator
line: This L-shaped structure. isn't that the fountain? The one with the statues. The tavern was directly across the street, here. The communicator could have slipped out of my pocket when we sat down.

title: The Communicator
line: It's a good place to start. You've got the Bridge. Tell Doctor Phlox we're going to need his cosmetic services again.

title: The Communicator
line: You could use another set of eyes down there, Captain.

title: The Communicator
line: I appreciate the offer, Trip, but the fewer set of eyes, the better.

title: The Communicator
line: I'm a regular bloodhound.

title: The Communicator
line: Next time.

title: The Communicator
line: We'll be in range of their surveillance towers in less than two minutes.

title: The Communicator
line: The hull plating's already been polarized.

title: The Communicator
line: Your feet ready for another hike?

title: The Communicator
line: It's not a problem, sir. Captain. my carelessness was inexcusable. I'm prepared for whatever reprimand you feel is appropriate.

title: The Communicator
line: How about thirty years in the brig, or maybe a good flogging?

title: The Communicator
line: Sir,

title: The Communicator
line: It was an accident, Malcolm. It could have happened to any of us.

title: The Communicator
line: Three military aircraft, seventy two kilometers off starboard. I suggest you increase our descent vector. That should keep us well below their visual threshold.

title: The Communicator
line: This was the table?

title: The Communicator
line: Positive.

title: The Communicator
line: Try your scanner.

title: The Communicator
line: Welcome back. What would you like?

title: The Communicator
line: Can you give us a few minutes?

title: The Communicator
line: Of course. Where's your friend? The young woman.

title: The Communicator
line: You have a good memory.

title: The Communicator
line: She was difficult to forget.

title: The Communicator
line: I'll pass along the compliment.

title: The Communicator
line: Do you live here?

title: The Communicator
line: No, just visiting.

title: The Communicator
line: We received a shipment of Allakas malt this afternoon.

title: The Communicator
line: Sounds good.

title: The Communicator
line: I've got it.

title: The Communicator
line: Where?

title: The Communicator
line: It's in a room, off that corridor.

title: The Communicator
line: Were you in there?

title: The Communicator
line: No.

title: The Communicator
line: There are two people inside.

title: The Communicator
line: Better wait till they come out. (They go back into the main room, and three men stand up. A fight starts, but Reed is knocked down and Archer has a gun jammed in his back. They're hauled off into that back room, where Pell holds up the missing communicator.)

title: The Communicator
line: Does this belong to you? What is it?

title: The Communicator
line: I don't know.

title: The Communicator
line: What kind of weapon is this? Where's General Gosis?

title: The Communicator
line: On the Eastern perimeter.

title: The Communicator
line: Send a level four communiqué and tell him I think we've found a pair of enemy spies. Take them to the Complex and put your men on alert. You won't be seeing your friends in the Alliance for a long time.

title: The Communicator
line: I'm telling you, something's gone wrong. We should hail them.

title: The Communicator
line: If they're in a public place, the communicator would draw attention.

title: The Communicator
line: We'll have to take that risk. T'Pol to Captain Archer.

title: The Communicator
line: The comm. line's open.

title: The Communicator
line: Captain, please respond. Close the channel.

title: The Communicator
line: Did you get a fix on the signal?

title: The Communicator
line: Somewhere in this district.

title: The Communicator
line: That's more than thirty kilometers from the tavern. Where's the shuttlepod?

title: The Communicator
line: It hasn't moved.

title: The Communicator
line: They couldn't have traveled that far on foot. Not that fast.

title: The Communicator
line: Maybe they took a train or a car.

title: The Communicator
line: If there was a change of plan, they would've told us.

title: The Communicator
line: Try to isolate their biosigns. I want to know exactly where they are.

title: The Communicator
line: There are nearly a hundred thousand people in that part of the city.

title: The Communicator
line: We'd have more luck if we moved into a lower orbit.

title: The Communicator
line: Any closer and we'd be detected. Do your best.

title: The Communicator
line: Still bothering you?

title: The Communicator
line: I didn't have time to visit the doctor. I wonder if the guard would bring us some Epsom salts, if I asked politely.

title: The Communicator
line: I wouldn't count on it.

title: The Communicator
line: We came down to retrieve my communicator. Now we've lost two of them. Not to mention my phase-pistol and a pair of scanners.

title: The Communicator
line: I just hope they don't find the shuttlepod.

title: The Communicator
line: If they really think we are spying for this Alliance, perhaps we should consider telling them the truth.

title: The Communicator
line: I'm not sure anyone would believe us.

title: The Communicator
line: It couldn't hurt to try.

title: The Communicator
line: Visitors from another world? There's no way to know how they'd react. The less we say the better.

title: The Communicator
line: Understood.

title: The Communicator
line: Follow me.

title: The Communicator
line: Which of you is the Captain? Something unexpected happened when I was examining this transmitter. It began to make a sound, so I opened it. Someone calling herself T'Pol seemed very concerned about her Captain's well-being. Which one of you was she trying to contact?

title: The Communicator
line: I'm the Captain.

title: The Communicator
line: The Alliance must be growing desperate if they're recruiting military officers as spies.

title: The Communicator
line: We're not part of the military.

title: The Communicator
line: I suppose you're the Captain of a pleasure boat. This transceiver, what's its frequency, its range?

title: The Communicator
line: I don't know.

title: The Communicator
line: This appears to be a computing instrument. Tell me, how does it work?

title: The Communicator
line: My superiors expect answers. As an officer, I'm sure you can appreciate that. I have no desire to harm you, but I need you to cooperate.

title: The Communicator
line: I'm sorry. I can't help you.

title: The Communicator
line: I trust you enjoyed the rally this morning. That's why you're here, isn't it? It's curious, the two of you visiting the city the same day as Chancellor Kultarey. Did you come here to observe his security arrangement? Or perhaps assassinate him? We're aware of your ancestral claims against our city. It must make a tempting target.

title: The Communicator
line: We're visitors, not spies.

title: The Communicator
line: This T'Pol who tried to contact you, where is she? (Pell hits Archer again, and he falls to the floor. Reed leaps up and is clubbed by a soldier with a rifle. When they are hauled back onto the chairs, Gosis spots that Archer's prosthetic forehead has come away at the edge and he peels it off. Pell does the same to Reed.)

title: The Communicator
line: You've been surgically altered.

title: The Communicator
line: General. His blood. It's red.

title: The Communicator
line: Take them to Temec. Have him perform a full examination.

title: The Communicator
line: They're here, inside this compound.

title: The Communicator
line: Guard towers, gun emplacements, it's not a hotel.

title: The Communicator
line: We could take Shuttlepod two, set it down here. They're being held less than thirty meters away. We'd be back in orbit before anyone knew they were gone.

title: The Communicator
line: If you were captured, you'd be giving the inhabitants more technology. It would undoubtedly affect the evolution of their society.

title: The Communicator
line: What if they didn't see us coming? We've still got that Suliban cell-ship, the one we used to rescue Klaang from the Helix. I've been working on it in my free time. I'm pretty close to figuring out how it works. If I can bring the cloak on line, we can get past their defenses, grab our people, and no one will see a thing.

title: The Communicator
line: Work quickly.

title: The Communicator
line: I could use a hand.

title: The Communicator
line: Aye, sir.

title: The Communicator
line: I suggest we monitor the communiqués coming from the compound. They may tell us what's happening to the Captain and Mister Reed.

title: The Communicator
line: Right away.

title: The Communicator
line: I don't get it. The power converter's engaged. Juice is definitely flowing through these relays. So why can we still see the ship?

title: The Communicator
line: Maybe this panel isn't the cloaking device.

title: The Communicator
line: I've identified every other component. It's got to be it. Run the power-up sequence again.

title: The Communicator
line: This would be a lot easier if there was a button marked cloak.

title: The Communicator
line: Hold on a minute, Travis. (Tucker presses a device to the center of a display - there's a shock and he's thrown back out of the ship.)

title: The Communicator
line: Are you all right?

title: The Communicator
line: Just got the wind knocked out of me a bit.

title: The Communicator
line: Maybe a little more than that.

title: The Communicator
line: Is there any pain?

title: The Communicator
line: It tingles a little.

title: The Communicator
line: Can you move your fingers?

title: The Communicator
line: How's that?

title: The Communicator
line: You tell me.

title: The Communicator
line: They feel all right. What's your scanner say?

title: The Communicator
line: Very little, I'm afraid. Quantum physics is hardly my specialty, but I'd guess that you received an intense dose of whatever particle radiation that ship uses to conceal itself.

title: The Communicator
line: Are you saying I'm permanently cloaked?

title: The Communicator
line: It's difficult to determine, but I suspect your appendage will eventually re-materialize on its own.

title: The Communicator
line: Eventually?

title: The Communicator
line: Come back in an hour. I'll check on your progress.

title: The Communicator
line: What am I supposed to do in the meantime? I can't work like this.

title: The Communicator
line: I'd also recommend a fresh uniform.

title: The Communicator
line: Thanks.

title: The Communicator
line: Shall we try this?

title: The Communicator
line: It's some kind of coherent energy pulse. I thought this technology was only theoretical.

title: The Communicator
line: Our Alliance friends seem to have turned theory into reality.

title: The Communicator
line: May I?

title: The Communicator
line: There appears to be another setting. (He fires at the crate, and it disintegrates in a big shower of sparks.)

title: The Communicator
line: If the Alliance has equipped its troops with these weapons. Make sure the devices are kept under guard at all times. Use men you can trust.

title: The Communicator
line: What did you find?

title: The Communicator
line: See for yourself.

title: The Communicator
line: How is this possible?

title: The Communicator
line: There's only one explanation. Our prisoners belong to another species.

title: The Communicator
line: Doctor Temec tells me your deformities are not the work of a surgeon. He found no obvious incisions or scar tissue. You're even more abnormal on the inside. A redundant renal organ and you're missing four thoracic vertebrae. Temec can't even begin to explain this mass. As for your red blood, the doctor tells me your hemoglobin is based on iron, a toxic element. He conducted the test four times to be certain. He has a theory about where you came from. I found it difficult to believe until I saw this. One of our surveillance aircraft took this image early this morning. The pilot said the object was traveling at very high speed. Can you explain?

title: The Communicator
line: None of the other planets in our system are capable of supporting life. Where do you come from?

title: The Communicator
line: Our scientists tell me it's unlikely that a craft of this size could have traveled from another star system. They suspect a larger ship must be somewhere nearby. Perhaps orbiting our planet.

title: The Communicator
line: Tell me your orders! Have you made contact with the Alliance?

title: The Communicator
line: Answer me.

title: The Communicator
line: Our intelligence reports underestimate you, General. Alien creatures, You're even more delusional than we thought. This isn't a spaceship. It's suborbital. A highly experimental aircraft. We've been observing your territory for months.

title: The Communicator
line: How did you evade our surveillance towers?

title: The Communicator
line: It's made from a composite alloy. Invisible to any of your tracking systems.

title: The Communicator
line: And your biological anomalies?

title: The Communicator
line: We've been genetically enhanced.

title: The Communicator
line: What kind of enhancements?

title: The Communicator
line: Our immune systems are resistant to chemical and biological weapons, and our internal organs have been modified to increase cellular regeneration by thirty percent. That way, our wounds can heal more quickly.

title: The Communicator
line: Create the perfect soldier.

title: The Communicator
line: How many of you are there?

title: The Communicator
line: We're prototypes, the only ones.

title: The Communicator
line: And your devices, are they prototypes as well?

title: The Communicator
line: All of them.

title: The Communicator
line: Take them back.

title: The Communicator
line: Do you believe them?

title: The Communicator
line: It's a plausible explanation.

title: The Communicator
line: The Alliance could have thousands of soldiers with these mutations.

title: The Communicator
line: We need to verify what they've told us.

title: The Communicator
line: I ran every imaginable test. If I were to extract the organs, I could study them in more detail.

title: The Communicator
line: You'll be in charge of the execution. I'll inform the prisoners.

title: The Communicator
line: Sub-Commander, another communiqué. It's from a General Gosis to the Chancellor. He said they've captured two enemy spies. They're going to hang them.

title: The Communicator
line: Reconnect the diffraction relays and we'll give it another shot. (He sneaks another look under his rubber glove.)

title: The Communicator
line: Any change?

title: The Communicator
line: Still missing in action.

title: The Communicator
line: Having a cloaked hand could have its advantages. Be useful in a poker match.

title: The Communicator
line: I could probably become a world-class magician.

title: The Communicator
line: It might be helpful on movie night, if you bring a date. In case you want to steal some popcorn.

title: The Communicator
line: Let's try it again.

title: The Communicator
line: Go ahead.

title: The Communicator
line: Is it working?

title: The Communicator
line: Not exactly. Shut her down. The cloaking generator's running at a hundred and ten percent, and it's still not enough. Let's route more power from the warp relays. Maybe that will do the trick.

title: The Communicator
line: How soon can you launch?

title: The Communicator
line: We're still reconfiguring the power matrix but I'm pretty confident

title: The Communicator
line: You don't have time. They're going to be executed in less than two hours.

title: The Communicator
line: We'll get it working on our way down if we have to. Look, invisible or not, this cell ship can take more of beating than our shuttlepod.

title: The Communicator
line: You're about to find out. Prepare it for launch.

title: The Communicator
line: An upset stomach? Do you really think he'd fall for that?

title: The Communicator
line: Well, it may be an old trick where we come from, but maybe they haven't heard of it here.

title: The Communicator
line: Even if we got out of the compound, we'd never make it to the shuttle. Not looking like this. Genetic enhancements. Very creative, Malcolm.

title: The Communicator
line: Thanks. Improvisation isn't my strong suit.

title: The Communicator
line: You made us sound like the Suliban.

title: The Communicator
line: What do you suppose Enterprise will do, after we're.

title: The Communicator
line: If I know T'Pol, she won't want to leave any contamination behind. It may take some time, but she'll find a way to get everything back. Including our remains.

title: The Communicator
line: It's ironic. Giving our lives to protect people who want to kill us.

title: The Communicator
line: It's a big planet, Malcolm. I'm sure they're not all like that.

title: The Communicator
line: I'm not afraid, sir.

title: The Communicator
line: What if we did tell them the truth?

title: The Communicator
line: You said it yourself, Captain. They'd never believe us.

title: The Communicator
line: If we show them to the shuttlepod, bring the General up to Enterprise, give him the grand tour, top it off with dinner in the Captain's mess. We'd probably all have a good laugh over how he almost sent us to the gallows. I've gotten plenty of lectures on cultural contamination, but T'Pol never mentioned anything about sacrificing crewmen to prevent it.

title: The Communicator
line: If we did tell them who we are, maybe it would do them a world of good. Look what the Vulcans did for Earth.

title: The Communicator
line: That was different. These people haven't even split the atom yet. The Vulcans waited until we were ready. Until we had the ability to travel to other stars. We're doing the right thing, Malcolm. I'm sorry you won't get a chance to write that report.

title: The Communicator
line: It could still happen, sir. I'm expecting a rescue party to come barging through that door any moment.

title: The Communicator
line: We'll be in range of those surveillance towers in less than two minutes.

title: The Communicator
line: They'll never see us coming.

title: The Communicator
line: On your feet.

title: The Communicator
line: What was that?

title: The Communicator
line: There's a power drain in the cloaking generator.

title: The Communicator
line: Are the warp relays offline?

title: The Communicator
line: Primary and backups.

title: The Communicator
line: The weapon nodes are active. I thought we diverted power from the secondary systems.

title: The Communicator
line: We did.

title: The Communicator
line: They may have been programd to reactivate when we launched.

title: The Communicator
line: Three military aircraft off our port side. They're on an intercept course.

title: The Communicator
line: Travis, can't you hold this thing steady?

title: The Communicator
line: It'd be a lot easier if they stop firing at us.

title: The Communicator
line: Commander.

title: The Communicator
line: Stand by.

title: The Communicator
line: He's my tactical officer. He can tell you everything you want to know about the Alliance's troop deployments, their weapons.

title: The Communicator
line: Captain.

title: The Communicator
line: You don't need to kill him. (Gosis gestures with his head, and the pair are bundled up the steps to the gallows. Their necks are placed in the nooses with the knots by their left ears when a cloud of dust is suddenly kicked up, and a disembodied arm appears in midair, pointing a phase pistol. The man by the trapdoor lever gets shot first, then the other one on the gallows. The rest dive for cover. Tucker leaps out and heads to free Reed and Archer while T'Pol provides covering fire. They take cover.)

title: The Communicator
line: Your ride's here.

title: The Communicator
line: Sir, the phase pistol, our equipment.

title: The Communicator
line: Don't leave without me. (He provides the covering fire for the others to get into the cell ship and then dashes for the interrogation room. There's just one guard who is easily taken out. He grabs the x-rays, files and the equipment, and stuffs them into various handy waistcoat pockets, then heads back out and makes it into the cell ship.)

title: The Communicator
line: Let's go.

title: The Communicator
line: The shuttlepod's right where you left it, sir. We'll be there in two minutes.

title: The Communicator
line: Captain?

title: The Communicator
line: Sir, looking for this?

title: The Communicator
line: Come in.

title: The Communicator
line: I scanned the region ahead. There's a blue giant cluster three light years from our current position.

title: The Communicator
line: Any planets?

title: The Communicator
line: None that are inhabited.

title: The Communicator
line: Sounds like a nice change of pace. Have Travis set a course.

title: The Communicator
line: Yes, sir. Was there something else?

title: The Communicator
line: You took a risk coming down in that cell ship. Its cloaking device could have failed.

title: The Communicator
line: A calculated risk.

title: The Communicator
line: I'm glad you did it. What's important is that we got everything back, the communicator, the phase pistol, the shuttlepod. We could have done a lot of damage to those people if we'd left any of it behind.

title: The Communicator
line: We did do damage to those people.

title: The Communicator
line: We've changed their perception of the Alliance.

title: The Communicator
line: They now believe their enemy is capable of creating genetically-enhanced soldiers, not to mention particle weapons.

title: The Communicator
line: And thanks to that Suliban ship, they also think the Alliance has developed invisible aircraft.

title: The Communicator
line: You don't have to leave technology behind to contaminate a culture. You were willing to sacrifice your life to protect them. I would not have expected that.

title: The Communicator
line: You are making excellent progress.

title: The Communicator
line: Yeah? What about this?

title: The Communicator
line: That's nothing.

title: The Communicator
line: Maybe nothing to you.

title: The Communicator
line: Give it time. Give it time.

title: The Communicator
line: Thanks, Doc. (As he presses the button to open the doors, we see there is still a small patch on Tucker's hand that is cloaked.)

title: Singularity
line: Science officer's log, August 14, 2152. Enterprise remains on course for the trinary system. I've transmitted a distress call but the nearest Vulcan ship is more than nine days away. By the time they arrive, they may only find debris, if that. Even if Enterprise makes it past the black hole without being destroyed, it seems likely the crew won't survive.

title: Singularity
line: I'm continuing my analysis of the condition that's stricken the crew. Without Doctor Phlox's assistance I'm not hopeful about reversing its effects. I'm documenting my findings so that Starfleet will at least have a record of what happened. The symptoms began not long after we set a course for the trinary system. That was nearly two days ago.

title: Singularity
line: You're sure it's a black hole?

title: Singularity
line: A class four.

title: Singularity
line: According to the Vulcan star charts, your people have surveyed more than two thousand of these things.

title: Singularity
line: That's correct, but none of them were part of a trinary star system.

title: Singularity
line: How close can we get?

title: Singularity
line: The gravitational shear between the stars is extreme. We'd have to drop to impulse, but we should be able to approach to within five million kilometers.

title: Singularity
line: Close enough to get some nice pictures.

title: Singularity
line: How long would it take to reach the system at impulse?

title: Singularity
line: Two days.

title: Singularity
line: Set a course.

title: Singularity
line: Trip. If you've got some free time, I'd love it if you take a look at my chair.

title: Singularity
line: Sir?

title: Singularity
line: The Captain's chair.

title: Singularity
line: Wh-What about it?

title: Singularity
line: You may have noticed that I don't sit in it very much.

title: Singularity
line: Is there a problem?

title: Singularity
line: It's uncomfortable. When I lean back I feel like I'm about to slide out of it. I have to sort of perch on the edge.

title: Singularity
line: I always assumed it was the best seat in the house.

title: Singularity
line: Take a look at it for me?

title: Singularity
line: I was going to purge the impulse manifolds.

title: Singularity
line: The chair first, if you don't mind.

title: Singularity
line: Aye, aye, sir.

title: Singularity
line: Come in.

title: Singularity
line: Good morning.

title: Singularity
line: Morning.

title: Singularity
line: Am I interrupting?

title: Singularity
line: No, no. Just thinking about something.

title: Singularity
line: Today's duty roster.

title: Singularity
line: Thanks.

title: Singularity
line: Lieutenant Reed has a new security protocol he'd like to diskuss with you.

title: Singularity
line: I'll drop by the Armory. Anything else?

title: Singularity
line: Chef didn't report for duty this morning. He's ill.

title: Singularity
line: Is it serious?

title: Singularity
line: Doctor Phlox said it's a simple virus. He should be fine after a few days' rest. Ensign Sato has offered to take charge of the mess hall. Apparently, she spends some of her free time in the Galley and is eager for an opportunity to cook for the crew.

title: Singularity
line: If it's all right with Chef. Let me ask you a question. I received a manuscript from Earth. A biography of my father. I've been asked to write the preface. Would you mind reading it when I'm done?

title: Singularity
line: I'd be happy to.

title: Singularity
line: If I can ever get it finished. I've been putting it off for weeks.

title: Singularity
line: The next two days should provide you with ample opportunity.

title: Singularity
line: It's not that I haven't had the time. They only asked for a page. How am I supposed to sum up my father's life in a page? It would've been easier if they'd asked me to write the book.

title: Singularity
line: Perhaps by focusing on one incident, a single event that exemplifies your relationship with your father, you'll be able to condense your thoughts.

title: Singularity
line: A logical approach. Maybe you'd like to write it for me?

title: Singularity
line: I'm hardly qualified.

title: Singularity
line: Chef was planning to make fried chicken tonight with scalloped potatoes and some of the Minaran spinach we picked up on Risa.

title: Singularity
line: The orange spinach?

title: Singularity
line: He's convinced there's a way to make it edible.

title: Singularity
line: Why don't we let him tackle that when he gets back? I have something else in mind.

title: Singularity
line: It's one of my grandmother's specialties. The recipe's been passed down for generations.

title: Singularity
line: I'll need a translation before I can program the protein resequencer.

title: Singularity
line: Oh no. You can resequence all the chicken and potatoes you want, but I am making this from scratch.

title: Singularity
line: Ensign. Is there something I can do for you?

title: Singularity
line: I've got a little headache. Nothing serious.

title: Singularity

title: Twilight

line: To my homeworld. We'll be there in three days. For the last century, a violent group of heretics have tried to undermine our way of life. With your ship I can deliver a final, decisive attack. I can end this conflict forever.

title: Chosen Realm
line: A war. That was the glorious mission you were talking about?

title: Chosen Realm
line: I'm trying to save my people.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Why do I have the feeling these heretics would say the same thing.

title: Chosen Realm
line: They might very well, but it doesn't change what they are. Enemies of the truth.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Your truth.

title: Chosen Realm
line: There's only one.

title: Chosen Realm
line: How many people do you intend to kill with my ship?

title: Chosen Realm
line: Your species is obsessed with numbers. A characteristic of your misguided belief that the secrets of the universe can be revealed through science. This may sound barbaric to you, but it doesn't matter how many heretics die. When the Makers return, only the faithful will survive. Non-believers will be swept away. Not only Triannons, but every race within the Chosen Realm.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Doctrines like that make it real easy to wipe out everyone who doesn't agree with you.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You're wrong. It's not easy. If it were, I wouldn't be dreading what I have to do next. I've been reviewing your records. You've committed terrible acts of desecration. Not only have you flown within the cloaking barrier of three Spheres, you've landed on one and entered another. For crimes of this magnitude my faith obligates me to destroy your ship and put your crew to death. However, I cannot ignore the fact that you put yourselves at risk to save us, and that I like you, Captain. I believe you're an honorable man, so I am going against what my faith dictates. I'm going to temper the punishment. As Commander of this ship you may choose one member of your crew to give up their life.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You're out of your mind.

title: Chosen Realm
line: If you won't choose, I'll choose for you. I take no pleasure in this, Captain, believe me.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I need time to think about this.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You have six hours. I urge you to use this time to search within yourself, and put these lies out of your mind. All of this data that you've collected must be erased from existence.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Six hours, Captain.

title: Chosen Realm
line: An update on the repairs to your ship. D'Jamat felt you should be kept appraised.

title: Chosen Realm
line: That's very considerate of him. Wait a minute. Your name's Yarrick, isn't it?

title: Chosen Realm
line: It is.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I understand your wife paid a visit to Sickbay. She had a long talk with my doctor. She's pregnant.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Yes.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I guess you also know she wants to end the pregnancy.

title: Chosen Realm
line: That's between her and me.

title: Chosen Realm
line: My doctor got the impression that she doesn't exactly agree with D'Jamat's interpretation of your faith. As a matter of fact, Phlox said she's grown to hate everything about it.

title: Chosen Realm
line: That's not true.

title: Chosen Realm
line: He also got the impression that you're not happy with the way things are going either.

title: Chosen Realm
line: D'Jamat is my spiritual leader. I will follow him to my death.

title: Chosen Realm
line: From what I've seen, I'm pretty sure you're going to have that opportunity.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You went to the doctor. You've put us at risk. He told his Captain.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Does D'Jamat know?

title: Chosen Realm
line: I don't think so. Did you have the procedure?

title: Chosen Realm
line: No, the doctor said he needed time to review our physiology. He's under guard now. It's too late.

title: Chosen Realm
line: It's just as well.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Have you changed your mind?

title: Chosen Realm
line: I'm not certain it's the right thing to do.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I won't watch my son or daughter fight in D'Jamat's war.

title: Chosen Realm
line: We have the ship now. We'll end the war once and for all.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You don't believe that any more than I do.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Enter. Ah, I'm glad you've come. I was just looking at your Captain's Logs. I had no idea we were such kindred spirits.

title: Chosen Realm
line: What makes you think that.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I know why you're here, in the Expanse. It turns out we're both fighting to save our people.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I'm trying to stop my world from being destroyed. You're trying to wipe out everyone who doesn't share your beliefs.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Our situations aren't as different as you think.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I draw the line at murdering innocent people.

title: Chosen Realm
line: And not torture? In your log there is an incident with a prisoner. An interrogation that made use of an airlock.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I needed information critical to my mission. He wasn't hurt.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I sympathize with you, Captain. I've had to make hard choices as well. When I was young, I fought with the Holy Regiments. I was commanding a mission. We'd infiltrated a village known to be a heretic stronghold. We were instructed to stay concealed and relay intelligence about enemy movements, but one of the villagers diskovered us. It was a small boy, no more than six years old. We knew if we let him go he would alert the village, and if we tried to hold him he might give us away. There was only one action to take, so I took it.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You're proud of that.

title: Chosen Realm
line: In the service of the Makers, all actions are blessed ones.

title: Chosen Realm
line: There are no Makers. At least, not how you perceive them. The Spheres are machines built for a reason you and I don't understand.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I was once like you, but then I felt the Breath. I prayed for you, Captain. I had hoped that the Makers would open your eyes to the truth, but it seems that they've turned away. You had a choice to make.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I've made it.

title: Chosen Realm
line: And which crew member have you selected?

title: Chosen Realm
line: I've chosen myself. You wanted to kill someone, kill me.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I urge you to reconsider.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I won't make someone else pay for something that happened under my command.

title: Chosen Realm
line: But what about your mission? When I'm through with your ship, your crew will need their Captain.

title: Chosen Realm
line: T'Pol's a fine commander.

title: Chosen Realm
line: We are more alike than you think, Captain. I would make the same choice. I respect your decision.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Then maybe you'll grant a request.

title: Chosen Realm
line: What is it.

title: Chosen Realm
line: My people have certain customs regarding death. There's a device on board. We use it to dispose of hazardous materials but, on rare occasions, when the situation arises, we've also used it for executions. It's considered humane.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Where is this device?

title: Chosen Realm
line: The molecules have been disassembled. Quick and painless.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I can't chance your mind?

title: Chosen Realm
line: No more than I can change yours.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Very well. Proceed.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Captain.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Ask Phlox to keep an eye on Porthos. Take care of Enterprise.

title: Chosen Realm
line: This won't end here.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You have my sympathies. You should inform your crew. They deserve to know.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You've been quiet.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I'm just thinking about what's ahead, Pri'Nam.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I know you too well. Tell me what's wrong.

title: Chosen Realm
line: We've just begun this mission and already three people are dead.

title: Chosen Realm
line: And that bothers you.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Shouldn't it? These people are not our enemy.

title: Chosen Realm
line: They are non-believers. That makes them our enemy.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Why?

title: Chosen Realm
line: Do you believe the Makers speak through me?

title: Chosen Realm
line: Yes.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Then when you question me, you question the Makers, and there's a word for that. Heresy. Yarrick, when you begin to sympathize with the enemy you risk becoming the enemy.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Don't feed him cheese. Can you talk?

title: Chosen Realm
line: Go ahead.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Can you neutralize the organic explosives?

title: Chosen Realm
line: Need Triannon internal scans.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Can I help you?

title: Chosen Realm
line: I know, medical scans are against your beliefs. I don't think the Makers will mind.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Enter.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Lyaal's missing. He's not at his station.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Lyaal. Lyaal. We'll use the ship's internal sensors to find him.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I need to locate one of my men.

title: Chosen Realm
line: We're dropping out of warp.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Main power is being disrupted.

title: Chosen Realm
line: From where?

title: Chosen Realm
line: I can't identify the location.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I'm telling you, I didn't do anything. Ask your flunky over here. He's been looking over my shoulder the whole time.

title: Chosen Realm
line: It's true. He never left my sight.

title: Chosen Realm
line: This did not happen by accident.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Pri'Nam, there's something wrong with the EPS manifolds on deck D, section J15.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Yarrick, go with him.

title: Chosen Realm
line: It's on the left.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You past it.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You don't want to do that.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You can't win. They'll destroy the ship.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Not if you help me.

title: Chosen Realm
line: No.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You know this is wrong. Everything he'd doing, we can put a stop to it. All of it.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I won't betray my faith.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Your faith betrayed you. Is this really what the Makers want? To kill people by the thousands in their name? Is that the faith you were raised in?

title: Chosen Realm
line: No.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Then do what's right. If you don't help me, you'll be condemning your wife and child to death, because that's how this is going to end. As long as people like D'Jamat dictate what's true and what isn't, all you'll ever have is war.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Have you located Lyaal?

title: Chosen Realm
line: Internal sensors aren't functioning. Systems are down all over the ship.

title: Chosen Realm
line: What is it?

title: Chosen Realm
line: There's a convoy of ships approaching.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Let me see them.

title: Chosen Realm
line: These people you're fighting. What makes them heretics?

title: Chosen Realm
line: We believe the Makers created the Chosen Realm in nine days. They believe it took ten.

title: Chosen Realm
line: For that, you've been at war for over a century? Found it.

title: Chosen Realm
line: What is it?

title: Chosen Realm
line: The environmental controls need to be re-routed to Sickbay. That can only be done from the Bridge. I'm going to show you how to do it.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Why?

title: Chosen Realm
line: Doctor Phlox has synthesized an airborne agent. It neutralizes one of the enzymes used in the organic explosives, renders it inert.

title: Chosen Realm
line: They're hailing us.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Surrender now.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I have four ships.

title: Chosen Realm
line: If you had ten ships you wouldn't survive against this vessel. Run your scans. You'll see that I'm telling the truth. Surrender and you'll be treated fairly.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You consider us heretics. We know what you do to them, D'Jamat.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Target the lead vessel. Do what I say.

title: Chosen Realm
line: No.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Prepare to fire torpedoes.

title: Chosen Realm
line: One of the ships has lost engines.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Target their main reactor.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Don't worry, it's harmless unless it's agitated.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Captain.

title: Chosen Realm
line: We have to get to the Armory. We're retaking the ship. We need the MACOs.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Pri'Nam.

title: Chosen Realm
line: It's begun. What's the status of the engines?

title: Chosen Realm
line: We've located the problem. It's under repair. The warp reactor should be functioning in a few hours.

title: Chosen Realm
line: They're retreating.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Stay with them.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Do what I say! Bring us within firing distance. Prepare to lock weapons.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Careful, there's no antidote for the venom.

title: Chosen Realm
line: There'll be an extra helping of snow beetles for you tonight, young lady.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Their engines are at maximum. We're still gaining.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Good. We'll eliminate them one by one.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Hold your fire.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Don't move.

title: Chosen Realm
line: They're coming into range.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Lock weapons.

title: Chosen Realm
line: They're sending a transmission. They want to surrender.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Continue firing.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Weapons aren't functioning.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Archer to the Bridge. We've rerouted command functions to Engineering. I've taken weapons offline.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Find him.

title: Chosen Realm
line: We've also neutralized your organic explosives.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You're lying.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Go ahead, try to blow yourself up.

title: Chosen Realm
line: I'll wait.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Stand down before anyone else gets hurt.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You know I won't do that.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Pri'Nam! They're coming about.

title: Chosen Realm
line: They're firing again, Captain. I suggest you bring your weapons back online. Are you willing to sacrifice the lives of your crew?

title: Chosen Realm
line: Captain, it's Reed. We have the Bridge. This'd be a lot easier if I had weapons back.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Stand by.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Hail them.

title: Chosen Realm
line: This is Captain Archer. D'Jamat is no longer in control of this vessel. Please respond. We've retaken the ship. I'm in command again.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Why should I believe you?

title: Chosen Realm
line: I'm powering down my weapons. See for yourself.

title: Chosen Realm
line: They're moving off.

title: Chosen Realm
line: We just entered orbit around Triannon. Let's go.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You've done a terrible thing, Captain. You've interfered with something that was ordained. After centuries of fighting, I was going to bring an end to the war. We would have had peace.

title: Chosen Realm
line: Peace? One of my crewmen is dead, six others are wounded, my ship is damaged.

title: Chosen Realm
line: None of that is important. All that matters is the sacred truth.

title: Chosen Realm
line: You want truth? I'll show you some truth.

title: Chosen Realm
line: From what we've been able to learn, this happened eight months ago. Both sides have been decimated. There are no major cities left. Millions are dead. Your faith was going to bring peace? Here it is.

title: Proving Ground
